/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2193:./validate/v_2.md:5170:./analyses/deep_25.txt:35:4. **证据闭环**：最强闭环是“换辅助模态”消融。dense correspondence embeddings 全面超过 2D keypoints、silhouettes、part segmentation、3D skeletons、point clouds、SMPL parameters，证明重定义的“稠密对齐表示比稀疏参数更适合”是对的。组件表里，appearance baseline 在 VCCR CC 是 49.7 rank-1、40.2 mAP，完整方法到 59.8、48.6；CCVID 从 80.9、75.3 到 93.9、91.2。MRIE 相比简单融合带来大幅提升，说明不是单纯 gait 分支有效，而是 gait-appearance interaction 有价值。ECS、PCA 可视化、t-SNE 和激活图进一步证明 dense correspondence embedding 稳定，3D gait 比 SMPL 参数更成簇，融合后类间更清楚。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2197:./validate/v_2.md:5598:./analyses/deep_21.txt:5:1. **触发观察**：已有 VI-ReID 大多默认行人完整可见；已有遮挡 ReID 又多是单模态，做法是定位可见区域、丢掉遮挡区域。作者抓住的现象是：在 VI-ReID 里，遮挡不只是少了一块可见信息，还会让可见光和红外的缺失位置、退化形式不同，导致跨模态对齐更坏。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2198:./validate/v_2.md:5599:./analyses/deep_21.txt:7:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何关注可见区域”改写成“如何补全缺失身份线索”。关键词是 `completion perspective rather than discarding`、`cross-modality feature completion`、`token-level completion`、`region-level completion`、`multi-distribution consistency`。这一步很关键，它把旧问题里的“遮挡鲁棒特征提取”升级成“遮挡 VI-ReID 的跨模态补全”。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2204:./validate/v_2.md:5801:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:23:3. **机制怎么长出来**：机制基本是自然推出的。既然 2D 帧被遮挡和错位破坏，就用 SMPL/HMR 生成 3D mesh，转成 point cloud，再用 PointPillars 得到和 2D feature 对齐的 pseudo-image feature；CMF 用 deformable cross-attention 和 2D-3D 映射点做融合；SSTI 用 SMPL shape 参数建 spatial/temporal 两条注意力流，专门处理相似外观混淆。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2209:./validate/v_2.md:5884:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:857:1. **触发观察**：已有 VI-ReID 大多默认行人完整可见；已有遮挡 ReID 又多是单模态，做法是定位可见区域、丢掉遮挡区域。作者抓住的现象是：在 VI-ReID 里，遮挡不只是少了一块可见信息，还会让可见光和红外的缺失位置、退化形式不同，导致跨模态对齐更坏。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2210:./validate/v_2.md:5885:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:859:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何关注可见区域”改写成“如何补全缺失身份线索”。关键词是 `completion perspective rather than discarding`、`cross-modality feature completion`、`token-level completion`、`region-level completion`、`multi-distribution consistency`。这一步很关键，它把旧问题里的“遮挡鲁棒特征提取”升级成“遮挡 VI-ReID 的跨模态补全”。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2212:./validate/v_2.md:5892:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:942:3. **机制怎么长出来**：重定义之后，机制基本自然推出。图像和文本都建成高斯分布，均值表示语义中心，方差表示不确定性和范围；DRM 负责分布距离，CMC 让文本分布包含图像分布，IMC 让被遮挡或被掩码的样本分布包含完整样本。机制和叙事绑定很紧，因为每个损失都在维护“包含关系”。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2218:./validate/v_2.md:5926:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1146:1. **触发观察**：换衣视频 ReID 里外观不可靠，gait 是天然身份线索。问题是已有 2D gait 容易受视角影响，3D skeleton 和 SMPL 参数又太稀疏、低维，既不够判别，也和高维 appearance feature 难对齐。作者抓住的是“3D 信息有用，但现有 3D 表示形态不适合和 ReID 特征融合”。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2219:./validate/v_2.md:5928:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1150:3. **机制怎么长出来**：机制几乎是从重定义里长出来的。先在 SMPL mesh 上预训练 vertex embeddings，让嵌入距离对应 geodesic distance 和 tangent direction；再用 3D mesh recovery 和相机参数把顶点、采样表面点投影到 2D 图像，训练 U-Net 输出 pixel-level dense correspondence embeddings；视频帧串起来就是 3D gait field。然后用 local similarity learning 建模局部时空邻域，最后用 MRIE 的全局和局部代表 token 让 gait 和 appearance 高效交互。这里不是随便拼模块，主线是“稀疏 3D 先验变成稠密、时空对齐、可融合的 ReID 表示”。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2220:./validate/v_2.md:5929:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1152:4. **证据闭环**：最强闭环是“换辅助模态”消融。dense correspondence embeddings 全面超过 2D keypoints、silhouettes、part segmentation、3D skeletons、point clouds、SMPL parameters，证明重定义的“稠密对齐表示比稀疏参数更适合”是对的。组件表里，appearance baseline 在 VCCR CC 是 49.7 rank-1、40.2 mAP，完整方法到 59.8、48.6；CCVID 从 80.9、75.3 到 93.9、91.2。MRIE 相比简单融合带来大幅提升，说明不是单纯 gait 分支有效，而是 gait-appearance interaction 有价值。ECS、PCA 可视化、t-SNE 和激活图进一步证明 dense correspondence embedding 稳定，3D gait 比 SMPL 参数更成簇，融合后类间更清楚。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2269:./validate/v_2.md:7013:validate/v_3.md:1723:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2270:./validate/v_2.md:7014:validate/v_3.md:1761:../codex_review_raw.txt:4966:./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2277:./validate/v_2.md:7033:validate/v_3.md:4047:../litreview/reviews/lit_15.md:4238:切开点：最像 PDA，但 PDA 的“包含关系”来自文本和图像的抽象层级；我们这里的包含关系来自航拍低清、俯视、遮挡下的 3D 可见性。它也不同于普通跨视角对齐，不是假设两个视角应映射到同一点，而是假设航拍观测对应一个由 SMPL 可见部位和投影不确定性定义的身份范围。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:4077:./reviews/deep_16.md:172:- A 语义/VLM teacher: 已完成,见 experiments/paper_materials/newinfo_semantic_teacher-codex.md。结论是遮挡语义 teacher 对 SOLIDER 强主干整体偏负,FLaN-Net/π-VL/AG-ReID/LVLM-ReID/RMPSNet 等发表遮挡成绩多低于或接近现有强基线; 唯一值得先探的是属性 teacher 的可靠性噪声屏蔽,其次是 teacher 只用于属性级样本组织,两者都必须先做零训练探针。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:4098:./reviews/deep_16.md:2959:后三篇的定位也清楚了：扩散补全那篇把遮挡说成特征层污染并加检索后处理，HCCL 那篇把无监督跨模态的核心问题改成伪标签可靠性传播，CM2GT 那篇把可见红外错配说成单粒度对齐失败。下面我读它们的方法细节和关键证据段。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:4123:./reviews/deep_16.md:7610:1. 触发观察：遮挡不是简单少了一块图像，而是会让可见人体部位和遮挡噪声混在一起，导致局部匹配错位。作者还观察到 Transformer 越深，patch 特征越相似，动态掩码很难生成有效的部位原型。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:4124:./reviews/deep_16.md:7611:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡 ReID 从“抑制遮挡区域”改写成“即时提取可用姿态和可见部位原型”。关键词是 dynamic mask、prototype mask、valid subspace、non-occluded body parts、pose key-points。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:4125:./reviews/deep_16.md:7612:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果问题是“遮挡下可见部位需要被重新定位和匹配”，那么动态掩码、姿态热图、局部原型、非遮挡部位匹配就能顺着长出来。但这篇机制绑定不算特别紧，因为模块较多，MAM、MACM、PAM、FMM 都在承担一部分解释，容易显得是组合拳。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:4126:./reviews/deep_16.md:7614:5. reviewer 为什么买账：更买机制完整性和遮挡场景表现，不完全是视角。真正 novelty 来自“用动态原型掩码加姿态聚合做可见部位匹配”的组合，而不是单个模块。对我们有用的教训是，遮挡论文如果只是“加部位模块”，必须有强可视化和分模块消融支撑，否则视角不够硬。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:4127:./reviews/deep_16.md:7637:4. 证据闭环：证据比较直接。可视化显示 DDO 把注意力从白墙、遮挡物拉回衣服、脸和可见身体；MSE、余弦误差和 SSIM 显示补全后特征更接近干净特征；DDO 插到 TransReID 和 Pass-ViT 也有增益。HRR 的证据更复杂，Occluded-Duke 上 mAP 从 81.8 到 90.6，但 Occluded-ReID 上会从 92.3 降到 90.1，作者也承认图库身份样本少或重遮挡时中心会偏。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:4210:./reviews/deep_21.md:7661:1. **触发观察**：已有 VI-ReID 大多默认行人完整可见；已有遮挡 ReID 又多是单模态，做法是定位可见区域、丢掉遮挡区域。作者抓住的现象是：在 VI-ReID 里，遮挡不只是少了一块可见信息，还会让可见光和红外的缺失位置、退化形式不同，导致跨模态对齐更坏。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:4211:./reviews/deep_21.md:7663:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何关注可见区域”改写成“如何补全缺失身份线索”。关键词是 `completion perspective rather than discarding`、`cross-modality feature completion`、`token-level completion`、`region-level completion`、`multi-distribution consistency`。这一步很关键，它把旧问题里的“遮挡鲁棒特征提取”升级成“遮挡 VI-ReID 的跨模态补全”。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:4212:./reviews/deep_21.md:7709:1. **触发观察**：现有遮挡 ReID 常在 backbone 输出后用姿态或解析模型找可见区域。作者抓住一个更深的失败点：到输出层时感受野已经扩大，遮挡信息已经扩散到原本未遮挡区域，后处理式过滤太晚了。同时，关键点热图只覆盖点附近，关键点之间的身体区域会丢信息。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:4213:./reviews/deep_21.md:7711:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何在输出特征上找可见区域”改成“如何在中间层阻断遮挡信息扩散，并用骨架区域补足关键点之间的外观”。关键词是 `occlusion information diffusion`、`decouple pedestrian features and occlusion information`、`visible appearance region attention`、`skeletal area modeling`、`skeleton-modulated cross-attention`。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:4214:./reviews/deep_21.md:7715:4. **证据闭环**：最关键消融是 VARA、SAM、SMCF 分开加。VARA 证明中间层抑制有效，SAM 证明骨架区域比点热图更完整。进一步分析 VARA 插入位置，发现中层最好，这正好支撑“输出层太晚、低层语义不够、高层分辨率太低”的重定义。SAM 的 α、γ、T 可视化和不同遮挡程度可视化，也在证明骨架区域建模确实覆盖可见身体而抑制遮挡。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:4215:./reviews/deep_21.md:7733:这批论文的共同套路是：先找一个旧范式默认成立的假设，然后证明它在某个更真实场景里不成立。比如“遮挡就看可见区域”“光照应统一”“proxy 越近越正”“全局特征能代表伪类”“输出层再处理遮挡也来得及”“匿名就是改原图”。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:4725:./analyses/deep_1.txt:21:3. **机制怎么长出来**：机制基本是自然推出的。既然 2D 帧被遮挡和错位破坏，就用 SMPL/HMR 生成 3D mesh，转成 point cloud，再用 PointPillars 得到和 2D feature 对齐的 pseudo-image feature；CMF 用 deformable cross-attention 和 2D-3D 映射点做融合；SSTI 用 SMPL shape 参数建 spatial/temporal 两条注意力流，专门处理相似外观混淆。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2774:创新类型是新机制加工程组合。它抓住无监督 ReID 中聚类边界 hard sample 的伪标签不稳定问题，用最近邻样本约束和类间平衡损失处理边界，再用 ODE 引导的残差重构增强特征。能发靠的是伪标签边界样本这个明确痛点。story 是：无监督失败不是所有样本都错，而是边界样本反复污染聚类。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2777:创新类型是问题重定义和新数据利用。它把车辆图像从“噪声”改写成“有益结构噪声”，用车辆数据模拟真实遮挡并做正则。能发的 gap 是 occluded ReID 数据小，真实车辆遮挡常见但被丢弃。story 很强：噪声不是要清除，而是要可控注入，让模型学会在遮挡下识别人。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2780:创新类型是新数据设定加新机制。它定义 occluded VI-ReID，指出遮挡和跨模态会叠加造成空间错位和模态退化，并构造 Occluded-SYSU、Occluded-RegDB。能发靠新设定和补全机制双支撑。story 是：遮挡 ReID 不应只看可见区域，而要利用单模态上下文和跨模态互补信息补全缺失身份线索。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2792:创新类型是新机制。它批评已有姿态方法只在 backbone 输出端做 mask，导致遮挡信息已经扩散到高层特征里。它把姿态和骨架区域提前引入中间层，并用骨架区域建模和 cross-attention 融合。story 是：姿态不该只是后处理过滤器，而应该在特征形成过程中阻断遮挡扩散。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:199:**部位/掩码方向终审判负**（exp022-026，约30次训练，账本在 results.md + decisions.md#44）：抗遮挡重加权、构造掩码监督(软/硬)、语言部位分支(含忠实LGPA-D)全部在强主干上不成立。三路codex法医结论：PSG的姿态接地是LGPA-D全部集成选择的承重墙，无姿态版必败。唯一幸存=遮挡物贴图增广(Swin +0.83/+1.10)，但有先例非方法级。exp026确认种子(no-detach s1/s2)在 hyy 跑完即封档，不阻塞选向。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:215:**exp022 方块池掩码监督：判负在途，但诊断值钱。** s0 54.1/60.5（-0.3/-0.6 对同种子纯增广）、s1 53.2/59.2（-1.3/-2.2），s2 收尾中，数学上已够不着 +0.8 信号线。诊断（viz_occaware.py）：留出合成遮挡 IoU 0.9628（监督完全可学、跨图泛化），但真实遮挡 query 上头只认"最像贴图补丁"的物体，汽车/行人/雨伞全漏。结论：头学成了**贴图检测器**，根因是方块裁剪池与真实遮挡物分布错配，监督机制本身无罪。归因臂（W_OCC=0）双卡在 hyy 跑（~15:00 完），其 occ_bce 不降反升、α 深负的对照动态已记录。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:291:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_13.md:3256:“多分支、多粒度、多尺度”本身已经很拥挤。能发 B 类的不是再拼一个分支，而是先指出一个被忽略的真实失败机制，再让机制服务这个问题。对我们来说，最值得借的是三类写法：显式对齐、可靠性建模、源域或视角不平衡。衣服文本和普通多分支换衣方向不建议正面进入，除非能被 SMPL 或航拍地面的几何问题重新定义。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_10.md:378:**exp022 方块池掩码监督：判负在途，但诊断值钱。** s0 54.1/60.5（-0.3/-0.6 对同种子纯增广）、s1 53.2/59.2（-1.3/-2.2），s2 收尾中，数学上已够不着 +0.8 信号线。诊断（viz_occaware.py）：留出合成遮挡 IoU 0.9628（监督完全可学、跨图泛化），但真实遮挡 query 上头只认"最像贴图补丁"的物体，汽车/行人/雨伞全漏。结论：头学成了**贴图检测器**，根因是方块裁剪池与真实遮挡物分布错配，监督机制本身无罪。归因臂（W_OCC=0）双卡在 hyy 跑（~15:00 完），其 occ_bce 不降反升、α 深负的对照动态已记录。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3164:区别：最像 DMPF 和 DMIC，但它们处理的是 VI-ReID 的模态、姿态、相机差异。我们切的是航拍到地面的 3D 投影差异，同一个人体部位在图像中尺度、可见性和形变全部变了。机制可以是把 2D token 投到 SMPL canonical body surface，再在 canonical 空间做身份表示，view-specific residual 单独建模。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3165:cheap kill-switch：不用训练新模型，先在 CARGO 或 AG-ReID.v2 上用现有 SMPL/pose 估计，把 SOLIDER token 按身体区域重聚合，比较原始全局特征和 canonical part 特征的跨视角同 ID 相似度。如果同 ID 排名或正负间隔没有明显改善，这条先停。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3168:挂靠资产：aerial-ground 数据和 pose 热图门控，必要时加 SMPL 可见性。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3169:区别：最像 DAMCL 和 DMIC。它们用相机 ID、Jaccard、动态邻域修 cluster，但仍然把相机差异当特征空间距离问题。我们把过切分和误合并解释为身体可见性不一致，例如航拍只稳定看到头肩轮廓，地面看到躯干衣着。机制是 visibility-aware clustering，先用 pose/SMPL 估计每张图可靠身体区域，再让伪标签只在可比区域上扩张。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3173:挂靠资产：SOLIDER-Swin 加 SMPL 3D 几何。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3174:区别：最像 DASA 和 DCR。DASA 用预训练卷积语义和 BN 适配，DCR 用属性文本做一致性桥。我们的切开点是 3D 几何坐标，它不是属性词，也不是旧分类器，而是跨域、跨视角、跨衣着都相对稳定的中间表示。机制可以是冻结 SOLIDER 主干，只训练 geometry-conditioned adapter，让旧域知识以 SMPL body surface token 或 joint-token 原型保存。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3175:cheap kill-switch：在现有顺序数据上做一个轻量探针，比较普通 SOLIDER 特征和 SMPL 分区后的特征在旧域遗忘样本上的互补性。如果 SMPL 分区特征不能挽回旧域近邻，或者和原特征高度冗余，这条不押。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3178:挂靠资产：aerial-ground ReID，加 SMPL 和 SOLIDER。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3179:区别：最像 DiverseReID。它强调动态风格多样性，但风格是统计意义上的。我们的切开点是 aerial-ground 的风格变化有物理原因，包括俯视角、低清、人体部位尺度压缩和遮挡模式变化。机制是 geometry-conditioned style hallucination，只生成符合视角和可见性的特征扰动。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3247:区别：最像 DAMCL 和 DMIC。它们用相机 ID、Jaccard、动态邻域修 cluster，但仍然把相机差异当特征空间距离问题。我们把过切分和误合并解释为身体可见性不一致，例如航拍只稳定看到头肩轮廓，地面看到躯干衣着。机制是 visibility-aware clustering，先用 pose/SMPL 估计每张图可靠身体区域，再让伪标签只在可比区域上扩张。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3251:挂靠资产：SOLIDER-Swin 加 SMPL 3D 几何。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3252:区别：最像 DASA 和 DCR。DASA 用预训练卷积语义和 BN 适配，DCR 用属性文本做一致性桥。我们的切开点是 3D 几何坐标，它不是属性词，也不是旧分类器，而是跨域、跨视角、跨衣着都相对稳定的中间表示。机制可以是冻结 SOLIDER 主干，只训练 geometry-conditioned adapter，让旧域知识以 SMPL body surface token 或 joint-token 原型保存。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3253:cheap kill-switch：在现有顺序数据上做一个轻量探针，比较普通 SOLIDER 特征和 SMPL 分区后的特征在旧域遗忘样本上的互补性。如果 SMPL 分区特征不能挽回旧域近邻，或者和原特征高度冗余，这条不押。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3256:挂靠资产：aerial-ground ReID，加 SMPL 和 SOLIDER。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_7.md:3257:区别：最像 DiverseReID。它强调动态风格多样性，但风格是统计意义上的。我们的切开点是 aerial-ground 的风格变化有物理原因，包括俯视角、低清、人体部位尺度压缩和遮挡模式变化。机制是 geometry-conditioned style hallucination，只生成符合视角和可见性的特征扰动。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_9.md:3368:和本批最像工作的区别：最像 `GSTNET` 和 `HGTDR`。但 `GSTNET` 用地理时间可达性约束群体图，我们用 SMPL 表面、关节投影和视角可见性约束航拍和地面之间哪些身体区域应该能对应。`HGTDR` 是遮挡恢复，我们不是补遮挡，而是定义跨视角下“可比区域”和“不可比区域”。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_9.md:3369:cheap kill-switch：不训练模型，先用现有 SMPL 或 2D pose 估计在 CARGO 或 AG-ReID.v2 上算可见性兼容分数。若同身份跨视角对的可见性兼容分数不能明显高于困难负样本，或者把该分数加到 SOLIDER 距离后 mAP 没有超过 0.4 的净增益，就先杀掉。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_9.md:3372:挂靠资产：SOLIDER-Swin、aerial-ground、SMPL。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_9.md:3373:和本批最像工作的区别：最像 `FMCNet+`。它补偿可见光和红外的模态特异特征，我们补偿航拍和地面视角下缺失的身体表面和局部身份残差。关键切开点是用 SMPL 可见性和姿态热图约束生成什么，不做无约束特征幻觉。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_9.md:3377:挂靠资产：SMPL 3D 几何、pose 热图门控、SOLIDER-Swin，若数据有 tracklet 再挂 aerial-ground 视频。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_9.md:3378:和本批最像工作的区别：最像 `GAE-Net`。它用 2D 步态轮廓辅助普通视频 ReID，我们用 SMPL 关节、体型和投影一致性作为跨视角教师，目标是解决航拍和地面视角差，不是普通 MARS/LS-VID 的外观鲁棒性。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_9.md:3379:cheap kill-switch：先做零训练或浅层探针。单独用 SMPL 关节比例、投影姿态、步态统计做检索，如果它对同身份没有独立信号，或者和 SOLIDER late fusion 不能带来超过噪声线的增益，就不要开大训练。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_9.md:3382:挂靠资产：aerial-ground、SMPL、SOLIDER-Swin。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_8.md:658:**exp022 方块池掩码监督：判负在途，但诊断值钱。** s0 54.1/60.5（-0.3/-0.6 对同种子纯增广）、s1 53.2/59.2（-1.3/-2.2），s2 收尾中，数学上已够不着 +0.8 信号线。诊断（viz_occaware.py）：留出合成遮挡 IoU 0.9628（监督完全可学、跨图泛化），但真实遮挡 query 上头只认"最像贴图补丁"的物体，汽车/行人/雨伞全漏。结论：头学成了**贴图检测器**，根因是方块裁剪池与真实遮挡物分布错配，监督机制本身无罪。归因臂（W_OCC=0）双卡在 hyy 跑（~15:00 完），其 occ_bce 不降反升、α 深负的对照动态已记录。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_8.md:734:阅读已完成：167 篇全覆盖。38 篇范围内精读 + 88 篇范围外粗读由 codex 完成（笔记 paper_notes/notes/in_*.md、out_*.md），剩 41 篇因 codex 额度耗尽（2026-06-11 13:01 恢复）由 Claude 摘要级补读（missing_41_skim_by_claude.md）。元分析和候选方向写在 **paper_notes/SYNTHESIS.md**，要点：(1) 在"单 embedding、测试无额外输入"口径下我们的 SOLIDER Swin-Small 纯基线 66.5 已处于已发表 B 类遮挡工作头部（发表水位 57.8-65.5，仅 arXiv 的 DPL-ReID 67.2 和测试期多部件距离的 AOANet 70.6 更高）；(2) 模块类增益=弱基线假象（这批论文内部基线 48-53 起步），反向验证我们 13 个判负；(3) 站得住的增益全部来自训练期新信息源（VLM 语义/外部遮挡物数据/生成数据/分布先验）；(4) 空白=遮挡结构化 VLM 语义当纯训练期监督蒸馏进非 CLIP 强人本主干、测试回纯单 embedding，没人做过。候选 A=该语义蒸馏方向（先零训练探针：冻结 SOLIDER 特征能否线性解码 CLIP 属性/遮挡物标签，解码不出的残差是否关联检索错误）；候选 B=真实遮挡物数据源+分布先验（最便宜，A 的对照轴）；候选 C=干净到遮挡的结构保持蒸馏（中风险排队）；候选 D=可靠检索稿保底投 PRCV。待办：codex 额度恢复后对候选 A 做独立新颖性红队，然后交用户挑方向。未开任何实验。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp142/claude_review.md:13:exp109 证明了 oracle 上界为 +8.5% mAP（feature+weight replacement），说明 headroom 巨大。SKC 试图通过训练一个 self-contained completion module 来捕获这个 headroom，而不是在 test-time 直接抄 bank。这是一个合理的技术路径。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp142/claude_review.md:37:如果只有 `equal_concat` 涨而 `global` 不涨，那说明补全改善了 fusion 但没有改善单图表征，论文 story 会弱。exp109 的 oracle 是作用在单图表征上的，SKC 的论文价值取决于能否在 global 上也展现正收益。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp142/claude_review.md:57:这个设计非常干净：高置信关键点 (≥0.7) 更新 bank，低置信关键点 (≤0.3) 被补全，中间带 (0.3, 0.7) 两者都不碰。**无信息泄漏。**
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp142/claude_review.md:59:关键发现：bank 更新使用 `skc_completed_feats`（L1247），但由于 gate = 0 对所有 score > 0.3 的关键点，**高置信关键点的 completed 特征 === raw 特征**。所以 bank 实际上用的是未修改的特征来更新，不存在循环污染。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_19.md:2754:和这批最像工作的区别：它最像真实标签噪声那篇的“分清干净、模糊、错误样本”，但我们把噪声从标签层下沉到 token 层。每个身体区域都有可靠性，低清、遮挡、俯视压缩造成的区域不应该同等参与身份学习。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/lit_review_occluded_2025_2026.md:7:- **机制**：CLIP-based（冻结 ViT-B/16 图像+文本编码器）。每张遮挡图做 textual inversion 构造细粒度 prompt `"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*]"`：S*=主体身份 token、A*=可见属性 token（衣着/配饰，learnable queries+cross-attn）、**O*=遮挡物 token（显式在语言空间建模遮挡物本身）**。cross-attn 对齐 prompt 与可见区域 + 熵不确定性加权融合 {视觉,文本,cross-attn}。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/lit_review_occluded_2025_2026.md:8:- **结果**：Occ-Duke **65.5 mAP / 75.2 R-1**（CLIP 线 SOTA）。消融：S*→72.6/63.7，+A*→74.6/65.2，+O*→75.2/65.5（遮挡物 token +0.6/+0.3）。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/lit_review_occluded_2025_2026.md:9:- **新意**：CLIP-ReID 把整图映射成 1 个 pseudo-token（粗）；FLaN-Net 分解成主体+属性+**遮挡物** 三 token。**遮挡物 token 是没人做过的点**。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_1.md:12143:../codex_review_raw.txt:4433:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:30:"transfer_to_occluded": "The dissimilarity-driven dual-stage compensation is directly portable to occlusion. Treat occluded body regions as \"missing attributes\" and a holistic reference (a pose prototype, a holistic-image feature, or a clean part-feature memory) as the bridge: use cross-attention to compute a (1 − similarity) \"missing-ness\" mask over body parts/channels, inject only the missing content via channel gating + residual term, then run a refinement stage that subtracts content already present/inconsistent with the reference (weighted by reference-similarity) to avoid filling occluded regions with hallucinated or occluder-derived features. This separates \"fill what is missing\" from \"remove what is corrupted/distractor\" in one module, and the whole bridge+compensation apparatus is training-only so it adds zero inference cost — attractive for occluded ReID feature completion that today often hallucinates or copies occluder content.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_1.md:12144:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:14:"transfer_to_occluded": "Adapt the VCS \"corrupt-a-parsed-region + feature-consistency loss\" trick to occlusion: use human parsing (or an occluder mask) to identify non-target/occluded regions, synthesize occlusion by replacing those pixels with random pixels sampled from a per-batch pool, then add an L2/MSE alignment loss pulling the corrupted-image feature toward the clean-image feature. This is a training-only, self-supervised occlusion-augmentation regularizer that teaches the backbone to produce features invariant to corrupted/missing regions, without needing extra inference modules or pose at test time. The batch-pool pixel-shuffle (rather than zero/black masking) is the transferable detail — it injects realistic distractor texture instead of constant fills, which better mimics real occluders.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:21:"mechanism": "TTPM is a ViT + HRNet pipeline with three parts and no occlusion-sample augmentation. A Multi-patch Feature Encoder encodes intra-patch and inter-patch features (re-grouping patches at 2x scale with the cls token). Pose-Patch Mapping (PPM) builds a fine-grained, per-patch positional correspondence between M pose keypoints and N patches via a learned similarity S = gamma*D_M - eta*S_M that combines an affine-extended Mahalanobis distance and affine-extended cosine similarity, gates out low-confidence keypoints by a heatmap-confidence threshold, and selects the argmax-similarity patch per keypoint, thereby down-weighting occluded patches without coarse global pose mapping. A Texture-Aware Decoder (context-extraction MHSA layers + texture-extraction MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:22:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas for occluded ReID. (1) The pose loss L_p that explicitly minimizes cosine similarity between body-part features and non-human/background features — a cheap regularizer to suppress occluder/background leakage into the identity embedding, applicable to any pose- or part-based occluded model. (2) The texture-distinctiveness decoder channel aimed specifically at non-target PEDESTRIAN occlusion: when the occluder is itself a person, pose/structure cues fail (same skeleton topology), so using texture appearance distinctiveness (via pose-filtered queries cross-attending to contextual features) to push apart target vs distractor-person is a concrete mechanism for the under-addressed person-on-person occlusion case. Also transferable: replacing coarse pose-to-global mapping with a per-keypoint-to-patch confidence-gated argmax correspondence (Mahalanobis+cosine affine similarity) to localize visible regions.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:30:"transfer_to_occluded": "The dissimilarity-driven dual-stage compensation is directly portable to occlusion. Treat occluded body regions as \"missing attributes\" and a holistic reference (a pose prototype, a holistic-image feature, or a clean part-feature memory) as the bridge: use cross-attention to compute a (1 − similarity) \"missing-ness\" mask over body parts/channels, inject only the missing content via channel gating + residual term, then run a refinement stage that subtracts content already present/inconsistent with the reference (weighted by reference-similarity) to avoid filling occluded regions with hallucinated or occluder-derived features. This separates \"fill what is missing\" from \"remove what is corrupted/distractor\" in one module, and the whole bridge+compensation apparatus is training-only so it adds zero inference cost — attractive for occluded ReID feature completion that today often hallucinates or copies occluder content.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:37:"mechanism": "CSSA learns pixel-level part labels without any external pose/parsing model: it separates foreground from background by the heuristic that foreground feature maps have stronger L2-norm response, clusters foreground pixels via k-means across a clip (Np=6 fixed clusters), and uses cluster IDs as pseudo-labels to iteratively train a pixel-wise part classifier producing Np+1 confidence maps (parts plus background/occlusion). A CARE module aggregates the whole clip into a denoised video-level embedding (encoder-decoder with an identity cross-entropy bottleneck) and uses its cross-pixel cosine similarity to each frame pixel as a weighted residual gate that amplifies pixels consistent with the dominant identity and suppresses clutter/occluders. SGFA then builds the global feature pair-wise: each semantic part's contribution to the aggregated global vector is weighted by the product of its query and gallery confidence scores, so a part counts only when reliable in both images.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:39:"transfer_to_occluded": "Apply SGFA's pair-wise reliability product to occluded image ReID: when scoring a probe against each gallery candidate, weight each body part's contribution by the product of the part's visibility/confidence in the probe AND in that candidate (recomputed per pair), rather than a single self-visibility mask. This makes a region count only when it is uncorrupted on both sides — directly addressing the occluded-ReID failure where a part visible in the probe but occluded in the gallery still injects noise. The L2-norm-response foreground heuristic also offers a cheap occluder/background suppressor (occluders/background give weaker feature norm than the target body) usable to derive a soft visibility map without a parsing model.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:46:"transfer_to_occluded": "This paper IS occluded ReID, so the ideas are native rather than cross-subfield, but two components are concretely reusable in a different occluded pipeline: (1) Categorical learnable queries that explicitly separate \"visible-attribute\" tokens (A*) from \"occluder\" tokens (O*) via cross-attention to patches — i.e., learning an explicit occluder-description token forces the model to model the distractor rather than ignore it, which could be added to a non-CLIP backbone (e.g., Swin/PSG) as an auxiliary \"occluder branch\" whose features are pushed apart from identity features. (2) The entropy-based dynamic fusion: weight each candidate feature stream (global vs. part vs. pose-gated) by the entropy of its own ID-prediction distribution, so low-confidence (heavily occluded) streams are automatically down-weighted at the feature-fusion stage — a drop-in, training-only reliability gate that needs no extra labels and could replace fixed weights in a multi-branch occluded model.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:86:"transfer_to_occluded": "Apply the text-level orthogonal-projection disentanglement to occlusion: learn a dual prompt for the OCCLUDER/distractor (e.g. \"a photo of the [X]...[X] occluder\") alongside the ID prompt, then orthogonalize the occluder text feature out of the ID text feature (F_ort = F_id - proj of F_occ onto F_id) and use the purged ID text feature to guide the visual encoder via the non-local SIM. Because the non-local operation aggregates from spatially distant but semantically relevant regions, it is well suited to occluded ReID where visible body parts are scattered far from the occluded/corrupted region — letting the model pull ID evidence from non-adjacent visible patches rather than local self-attention that gets dominated by the occluder. The orthogonalization gives a clean way to subtract a known nuisance direction (occluder appearance) without an auxiliary parser.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:88:"novel_component": "Disentangling a nuisance factor by vector orthogonal projection in the TEXT embedding space: project the nuisance (clothing) text feature onto the ID text direction and subtract it, purging the nuisance-aligned component of ID features without any auxiliary visual model — a cheap, parser-free disentanglement that generalizes to any named confounder (including occluders)."
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:103:"novel_component": "Reframing an \"unwanted noise\" domain (vehicle images) as positive-incentive noise (π-noise) that, via information-theoretic argument, reduces the recognition task's conditional entropy — and operationalizing it as a cheap, annotation-free occluder source for realistic copy-paste occlusion augmentation rather than treating it as data to discard.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:119:"transfer_to_occluded": "Repurpose the mask-guided, pose-conditioned diffusion inpainting from \"swap the clothing region\" to \"fill the occluded region\": use a body-segmentation/visibility mask to mark missing or occluder-corrupted body parts, then inpaint them with OpenPose-keypoint-conditioned Stable Diffusion to synthesize plausible body content, generating occlusion-augmented training pairs (or recovered query images). Critically, transfer their two-stage quality gate — admit a recovered region only if its ReID-feature similarity to the clean identity is high and its FID is low — so hallucinated content is filtered before it pollutes training, addressing the chronic risk that completion/inpainting injects identity-inconsistent features in occluded ReID.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:127:"novel_component": "Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS): turning an explainability signal into a re-ranking operator — measure how much the model's attention overlaps the visible-body mask (IoU) and how mutually consistent query/gallery attention maps are, then asymmetrically shrink or inflate pairwise distances. It makes \"is the model looking at occluded regions?\" a concrete, label-free matching correction rather than a post-hoc visualization.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:141:"mechanism": "Per frame, an off-the-shelf 3D human reconstruction (HMR/SMPL) produces a pedestrian mesh, which is converted to a point cloud and back-projected with image RGB; a detection-free PointPillar backbone encodes it into a pseudo-image (\"pillar-based feature\") whose dimensions are aligned with 2D ResNet image features. A Cross-Modal Fusion (CMF) module uses deformable cross-attention where pillar features are queries and 2D-to-3D mapping gives reference points, so sampling locations on the image are anchored at projected pedestrian body positions. A separate Shape-aware Spatial-Temporal Interaction (SSTI) module runs parallel spatial/temporal self-attention over SMPL shape parameters (β) to form a video-level 3D-shape descriptor; CMF fusion features (after temporal aggregation) and the SSTI shape feature are concatenated as the final representation, trained with cross-entropy + triplet.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. For occluded ReID this gives a body-structure prior independent of pixel evidence: even when a region is occluded, the reconstructed mesh still provides a body-anchored query, steering attention onto plausible person regions and away from distractor occluders, and the pose/shape-derived reference points act as a soft visibility/structure guide. The SSTI idea of an appearance-independent shape descriptor (from β only) is also a complementary, occlusion-robust feature since estimated body shape is less corrupted by occluders than RGB texture.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:150:"transfer_to_occluded": "This paper IS occluded ReID, so the whole pipeline is on-domain, but the single most transferable trick is treating occlusion as an explicitly invertible map T in FEATURE space and learning T^-1 with paired clean/occluded-feature supervision — instead of masking/suppressing occluded regions, you generatively reconstruct the clean identity embedding before it reaches the ReID head. Concretely transferable pieces: (1) train a feature-space de-occluder on synthetic occlusion pairs (silhouette-guided background patching + Fourier-domain adaptation to bridge synth-to-real) where the FROZEN ViT clean feature is the ground truth, so no occlusion masks are needed at test time; (2) keep both reconstructed and raw occluded features and fuse them with cross-attention (Q=clean, K/V=occluded) rather than discarding the occluded one — the reconstruction acts as a query that re-attends the raw features toward visible identity regions, which is robust when reconstruction is imperfect; (3) the reconstruction-loss-as-classifier-guidance idea turns an unconditional generative module into an identity-preserving deterministic operator, directly useful for any completion-based occluded-ReID module to avoid hallucinating wrong identities.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:151:"novel_component": "Formulating occlusion as a deterministic, invertible transform T in deep-feature space and learning its inverse T^-1 via a latent diffusion model supervised by paired clean ViT features — i.e. feature-space inpainting where a reconstruction loss plays the role of classifier guidance, yielding a deterministic identity-preserving de-occluder rather than a stochastic sampler, and crucially requiring no masks/pose/parsing at inference.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:175:"transfer_to_occluded": "The first-order-difference split point on sorted G-to-patch cosine similarities is a cheap, supervision-free occlusion detector that could be dropped into an occluded-ReID pipeline to estimate which patches/parts are occluded, then drive part-visibility gating (mask occluded part tokens before matching) and a per-part visibility score for MaxSim-style partial matching — all without an external pose/parsing model. Complementary: the Push Loss that contrastively separates a learned background/occlusion feature from the foreground feature could regularize an occluder-aware feature space.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:181:"mechanism": "For video clothes-changing ReID, instead of using sparse 3D skeletons or low-dimensional SMPL parameters for gait, the method distills dense 3D mesh-surface knowledge into the 2D image domain. It pre-trains per-vertex embeddings on the canonical SMPL mesh via a GCN, supervised so that embedding L2 distances match mesh geodesic distances and embedding angles match surface tangent angles; a lightweight U-Net extractor is then trained to assign every foreground pixel an embedding equal to its underlying 3D vertex's embedding, forming a per-frame \"structured distilled 3D gait field\" that is spatially/temporally aligned with the video. Local similarity learning plus a dual-granularity token cross-attention module (MRIE) then fuse this gait field with clothing-desensitized appearance features.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:182:"transfer_to_occluded": "Adopt the dense pixel-to-3D-vertex correspondence embedding as an occlusion-aware matching substrate: train a per-pixel head that maps each foreground pixel to a canonical SMPL-vertex embedding (supervised by geodesic/tangent-consistent vertex codes). Then (a) occluded/missing body regions are explicitly detected as 3D vertices with no supporting pixel, yielding a per-vertex visibility/support map for free, and (b) two images are matched only over their shared visible 3D vertices (\"common visible support\"), making the comparison occlusion-robust without relying on holistic features. The cross-frame \"same-vertex => consistent embedding\" constraint also provides a structural prior to inpaint or down-weight corrupted regions.",

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/fm_occluded_reid_study.md:49:**decorr loss 全程活跃(稳 0.041)却完全没移动 Jaccard/oracle/fusion。** 机制：强迫 global 线性解相关对"排哪些 gallery"(part-MaxSim 排序)是**正交**的——检索由 part-MaxSim over 相同可见身体部位证据决定，两模型受**同一份可见证据**约束犯**同样的错**(Swin-only-r1-hit 370/989=37%，DINO 补 8=0.81%)。global 线性相关只是排序"装饰"。→ **显式施压也打不破张力 = 张力鲁棒、fundamental**。这是张力洞察最强的对照证据(诊断论文核心实验)。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/fm_occluded_reid_study.md:51:**收敛点(e30 matched)双确认**：λ=0 vs λ=1 同 rank16/seed/script 跑到 e30 oracle 仍**完全一致**——Jaccard 0.2646 vs 0.2627、oracle +0.85 vs +0.80、fusion best ALL 75.74 vs 75.73（λ=1 甚至略低）。**早期(e10)+收敛(e30) 双证据：解相关在任何训练阶段对互补性零效果。** 加上 decorr-floor 证据（λ=2 双倍权重只把 0.041 降 ~1% → ~0.041 是 ID-constrained floor，共享判别方向是 ID load-bearing 的、删不掉）。→ **张力对显式干预(e10/e30、λ∈{0,1,2}、λ=10 进行中)全程鲁棒，是 fundamental 的，不是可调超参。**

# GOPL 零训练 kill-switch 设计（2026-06-24, B containment 死后转向; novelty 7/10 存活）

## re-frame（定稿，绕开所有红海）
> 大家以为跨视角/遮挡 ReID 难在"特征对齐不够"，其实是 **正样本关系粒度错了**：ReID 训练把同一 ID 的所有 pair 当**等价**正样本强拉近，但两张图**共同可观测的人体表面**可能几乎不重叠（一张遮腿一张遮躯干→共同只剩头），此时"同一身份"是**过强监督**，会把不可对齐的远程正边硬拉，污染 identity manifold。
> **GOPL**：SMPL 共同可见表面 overlap 只当 **same-ID positive edge 的可靠性度量**——高 overlap 早期强拉、低 overlap 延迟/弱约束/桥接。SMPL **不进身份表征、不做推理匹配、不做 part alignment、不做增广**（绕开 exp333 SMPL-β≈random + VPM/QPM/visibility 红海 + GSAlign/ViSA aerial-ground 红海）。

## novelty caveat（codex 7/10, 必须遵守）
- 最危险撞车 **VPM/PVPM/QPM**（pair-wise 共同可见区域匹配/对齐）。切口=训练监督关系重定义，**不是**匹配/对齐。
- 论文**不能写**: 首次发现正样本不等价 / 首次用 visibility / 首次用 SMPL / 新 pose alignment。
- 论文**能写**: "revisit supervised ReID from positive-relation granularity"; "same-ID labels correct but not uniformly reliable under disjoint visible surfaces"; "SMPL only as geometry reliability meter, not identity rep / alignment"。
- **实验硬门槛**: 必须 beat ① random/loss-self-paced ② feature-distance hard/moderate positive mining ③ **2D-part-visibility / VPM-QPM-style overlap**。③最关键——若 2D 关节可见性解释得一样好, GOPL=老visibility换名, 死。

## 零训练 kill-switch（先验隐藏变量存在 + 证 SMPL 几何独特）

数据 occluded_duke（SMPL 缓存现成）。冻结一个**强 occluded_duke ReID ckpt**（agent 找最强的, 如 exp255/PSG 系或 exp341base; 报 mAP sanity）。SMPL: `cache/smpl_geom/{train,query,gallery}.npz` = 71 关节 pj2d(2D)+j3d(3D)+conf+valid。

**共同可见度量（多版本, 互为对照）:**
- `vis_i` = 关节可见性向量（conf > 阈值, 或 conf 连续）。
- `cov2d(i,j)` = 2D 关节共同可见 IoU = |vis_i ∩ vis_j| / |vis_i ∪ vis_j|（**这就是 VPM/QPM 式 2D-visibility 对照**）。
- `cov3d(i,j)` = 用 j3d + 相机朝向估每关节"表面是否朝向相机可见"（自遮挡), 再算共同可见 IoU（**这才是 GOPL 主张的 SMPL-3D**, 若 verts 需要 agent 按需重算 ROMP mesh; 关节级先做近似）。

**核心测试（query=遮挡, A→G occluded_duke 标准协议）:**
1. **同 ID pair 距离 vs overlap**: 所有 same-ID pair, frozen cosine 距离 vs `1-cov`。Spearman, 控遮挡程度(可见关节数)/bbox。预期: cov3d 的负相关显著, 且强于 cov2d。
2. **overlap 分桶**: same-ID pair 按 cov 四分位, 看 cosine 距离均值是否低 overlap 桶明显更大。
3. **query AP 分桶**: 每 query 按其 true-match 的 max cov 分桶, 看底桶 mAP/AP 是否显著低于顶桶。
4. **hard-positive tail**: cosine 距离最大的 top-k% same-ID pair(最难正样本)里, 低 cov 占比是否显著高(证现 loss 在强拉不该早拉的边)。

**破坏性/对照（每个都要报, 决定 novelty 生死）:**
- D1 置换 cov（shuffle overlap 值）→ 相关性必须消失。
- D2 **bbox/相机对** 当 overlap 代理 → SMPL cov 必须解释更多(更高 Spearman / 更大桶 gap)。
- D3 **feature-distance 本身**当难度 → SMPL cov 必须在 partial correlation 里**额外**加信号(控住 feature-distance 后 cov 仍解释)。
- D4 **cov2d vs cov3d** → cov3d 必须明显强于 cov2d, 否则 GOPL=VPM/QPM 换名(致命)。
- D5 随机关节子集当"可见" → 必须掉。

**通过标准:** (核心1-4成立) + (D1置换破) + (D2 SMPL>bbox/cam) + (D3 SMPL beyond feature-dist) + **(D4 cov3d>cov2d 明显)**。D4 不过 = GOPL 没独特性, 降级。全过 = GOPL 隐藏变量真实且 SMPL 几何独特, 写训练版(geometry-ordered positive graph + 课程权重, beat random/self-paced/feature-hard/2D-vis 四对照)。

## 不过的退路
- D4 不过(cov3d≈cov2d): GOPL 降级。转 p_3 遮挡 source-separation(donor-ID probe) 或 p_2 备选 SCEI(surface ACE)。
- 核心1-4 不成立(距离与 cov 无关): 整个"正样本关系粒度"假设错, 换方向。

## 资产
SMPL 缓存 lab-3090 `/root/work/SOLIDER-REID/cache/smpl_geom/`。occluded_duke `/root/work/SOLIDER-REID/data/occluded_duke`。强 ckpt agent 在 `log/occluded_duke/` 找。复用 error_analysis_geom.py / cvpb_containment_killswitch.py 的 extract/per_query_ap 基建。

./GOPL_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:4:> 大家以为跨视角/遮挡 ReID 难在"特征对齐不够"，其实是 **正样本关系粒度错了**：ReID 训练把同一 ID 的所有 pair 当**等价**正样本强拉近，但两张图**共同可观测的人体表面**可能几乎不重叠（一张遮腿一张遮躯干→共同只剩头），此时"同一身份"是**过强监督**，会把不可对齐的远程正边硬拉，污染 identity manifold。

./reviews/deep_16.md:7636:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果接受“遮挡是特征污染”，扩散式去噪补全就很自然。DDO 用冻结 ViT 的干净特征作监督，把遮挡特征恢复成干净特征。HRR 则利用身份中心先筛候选，再做局部重排序。不过 HRR 依赖闭集身份结构，协议风险比 DDO 大。
./reviews/deep_16.md:7637:4. 证据闭环：证据比较直接。可视化显示 DDO 把注意力从白墙、遮挡物拉回衣服、脸和可见身体；MSE、余弦误差和 SSIM 显示补全后特征更接近干净特征；DDO 插到 TransReID 和 Pass-ViT 也有增益。HRR 的证据更复杂，Occluded-Duke 上 mAP 从 81.8 到 90.6，但 Occluded-ReID 上会从 92.3 降到 90.1，作者也承认图库身份样本少或重遮挡时中心会偏。

./reassess.sh:10:- **死2(刚)**: GOPL'正样本关系粒度错了'(用 SMPL 共同可见人体表面 overlap 当 same-ID 正边可靠性)。冻结最强 occluded_duke ckpt(exp255, sanity mAP73.05≈训练73.2)测: cosine 距离确实弱负相关 overlap(rho≈-0.13)但: D5 随机关节子集打平(-0.1294≈真-0.1273)、cov2d 控住可见关节数后归零(+0.0145)、#vis 关节数 baseline 反而更强(-0.1321)、相机对(视角差)解释方差 eta²0.062 比 SMPL cov 0.018 还大、cov3d(3D自遮挡)没明显强于 cov2d → 隐藏变量是'遮挡越重越难'(occlusion-count)不是'共同可见表面', SMPL 几何=VPM/QPM/occlusion-count 换名无独特信号。
./reassess.sh:12:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。

./reviews/deep_3.md:6735:5. reviewer 为什么买账：卖的是“用反度量困难样本训练泛化能力”的视角。机制有些堆，但 perturbation 到 defense 的逻辑很顺。需要注意，ReID 对抗攻击早有先例，例如 MUAP 这类工作已经证明 ReID 排序容易被扰动攻击，APD 的新意在于把攻击思想转成 DG 训练样本和语义防御。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.14184?utm_source=openai))
./reviews/deep_3.md:6739:1. 触发观察：ReID 缺标注数据，渲染数据贵且粗糙，GAN 增广容易伪影和模式坍塌；扩散模型图像质量高，但用于 ReID 时最要命的是换姿态后身份一致性不稳。PIDM 这类扩散人像生成是直接先例。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.12500?utm_source=openai))
./reviews/deep_3.md:6747:1. 触发观察：CLIP-ReID 类方法已经很强，但它依赖整体语义提示，在遮挡和细粒度相似行人上容易只看主特征，漏掉头发、包、衣服细节。CLIP-ReID 与 CoOp 是它的直接技术背景。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.13977?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.01134?utm_source=openai))
./reviews/deep_3.md:6759:5. reviewer 为什么买账：卖的是视角和形式化机制。它不是说“我又对齐了一下”，而是说“过度对齐会损失有用细节”。近邻工作里 SGIEL 已经用正交子空间和形状擦除来挖 shared cue，LUPI 也用中间域补信息，所以 BDLF 的边界在“base/detail 相关性分解，而非额外生成或形状特权信息”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.04205?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.09348?utm_source=openai))
./reviews/deep_3.md:6763:1. 触发观察：2D ReID 受视角和背景影响大，3D ReID 理应解决，但已有 3D 方法多是把纹理贴到点云上做分类，实际没有充分利用 3D 的视角归一化，也没用好高分辨率纹理。3DInvarReID 等说明 3D 形状线已经存在。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.10658?utm_source=openai))
./reviews/deep_3.md:6766:4. 证据闭环：它必须证明两件事：UVTexture 的注意力比 2D 图像更对齐、更少受背景和视角影响；IAS 不只是好看，还能提升重排序结果。论文用 2D/UVTexture 激活图对比、双流对比、KNN/属性/解释重排消融和 aerial-ground 数据集结果形成闭环。AG-ReID.v2 这类跨空地数据也说明视角差异是真问题。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.02634?utm_source=openai))
./reviews/deep_3.md:6790:5. reviewer 为什么买账：卖的是“用反度量困难样本训练泛化能力”的视角。机制有些堆，但 perturbation 到 defense 的逻辑很顺。需要注意，ReID 对抗攻击早有先例，例如 MUAP 这类工作已经证明 ReID 排序容易被扰动攻击，APD 的新意在于把攻击思想转成 DG 训练样本和语义防御。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.14184?utm_source=openai))

./reviews/deep_3.md:6802:1. 触发观察：CLIP-ReID 类方法已经很强，但它依赖整体语义提示，在遮挡和细粒度相似行人上容易只看主特征，漏掉头发、包、衣服细节。CLIP-ReID 与 CoOp 是它的直接技术背景。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.13977?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.01134?utm_source=openai))
./reviews/deep_3.md:6814:5. reviewer 为什么买账：卖的是视角和形式化机制。它不是说“我又对齐了一下”，而是说“过度对齐会损失有用细节”。近邻工作里 SGIEL 已经用正交子空间和形状擦除来挖 shared cue，LUPI 也用中间域补信息，所以 BDLF 的边界在“base/detail 相关性分解，而非额外生成或形状特权信息”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.04205?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.09348?utm_source=openai))
./reviews/deep_3.md:6818:1. 触发观察：2D ReID 受视角和背景影响大，3D ReID 理应解决，但已有 3D 方法多是把纹理贴到点云上做分类，实际没有充分利用 3D 的视角归一化，也没用好高分辨率纹理。3DInvarReID 等说明 3D 形状线已经存在。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.10658?utm_source=openai))
./reviews/deep_3.md:6821:4. 证据闭环：它必须证明两件事：UVTexture 的注意力比 2D 图像更对齐、更少受背景和视角影响；IAS 不只是好看，还能提升重排序结果。论文用 2D/UVTexture 激活图对比、双流对比、KNN/属性/解释重排消融和 aerial-ground 数据集结果形成闭环。AG-ReID.v2 这类跨空地数据也说明视角差异是真问题。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.02634?utm_source=openai))

./pivot/p_3.md:1994:### ⚠️死亡清单碰撞(排除): 07的CIL-ReID=已kill 3次的donor-leakage; AGP/RWOA=遮挡红海pose/CLIP/part二次包装。
./pivot/p_3.md:2004:最快保底=#6。坚决不碰=donor-leakage及遮挡红海pose/CLIP/part再包装。
./pivot/p_3.md:2011:## ★★★ 最强收敛发现:同框"入侵身份泄漏"(co-present identity leakage)
./pivot/p_3.md:2012:**3 个独立 agent(读不同批)各自落到同一个角度**,且它正好是 reid-paper 项目自己最强的活口(D4 donor-leakage + 反事实一致性方法 6-7/10 待探针)。库 + 你自己的诊断 + 领域 gap 三方收敛。
./pivot/p_3.md:2015:Occluded-Duke 的遮挡**大比例是"另一个行人"而非物体**。全领域(167篇)把遮挡当"信息缺失→补全(completion/pose/part/CLIP)"。**真正失败不是缺信息, 而是 target embedding 被遮挡那个人的身份污染**——一个 distractor identity 泄漏进来。这是 source-separation 问题, 与全场"补全"范式正交。**没有一篇这么做。**
./pivot/p_3.md:2018:- **重定义失败源**: co-present 入侵身份泄漏(可命名、可测), 非"遮挡难"。
./pivot/p_3.md:2019:- **机制链**: ①训练分布改动——把**已知身份**的另一行人 crop 合成贴到目标(入侵者 ID 仅训练期可得=外部信息源); ②对 embedding 做入侵身份的**对抗/对比抑制**(不是 gate——occluder-gate 是墙); ③可选 target↔自身 holistic 一致性。
./pivot/p_3.md:2020:- **★"为什么有效"中间变量**: **入侵者身份探针**——训一个 probe 从 target embedding 预测同框入侵者 ID 的准确率=泄漏量。baseline 泄漏高, 方法压到随机, 且泄漏下降与 mAP 增益相关。
./pivot/p_3.md:2021:- **★杀手对照(正面打 wall-2 通用增益障碍)**: (i)打乱入侵者**衣服/外观**→增益应保持(治身份泄漏非外观); (ii)**Market(无遮挡)应不涨**→证非通用正则; (iii)人遮挡 split vs 物遮挡 split→增益应集中在人遮挡。
./pivot/p_3.md:2023:- **★廉价 kill-switch(一晚)**: 合成人遮挡上, 用强 baseline(Swin-Small)embedding 训入侵者-ID 探针。≈随机→强主干已抑制无泄漏可挖→kill; >>随机→有故事。
./pivot/p_3.md:2026:reid-paper 项目 D4 诊断**已确认 donor-leakage 人际混淆在强主干仍持续(≈3×物体干扰)**——kill-switch 其实已经过了。衍生"donor-leakage 反事实一致性"方法 6-7/10、待探针。**库读证明: 你这条自己的活口, 正好是整个领域的空白。**
./pivot/p_3.md:2029:- 与红蓝队判死的"主要人物归属/target ambiguity"**相邻**。区别(待验证): 这版=纯训练端抑制 + 可测泄漏变量 + Market 负对照 + 入侵者是真实行人身份, 不是测试期归属(那破坏单 embedding)。**开工前必须翻当年判死的确切理由**(redteam_final / next_direction_after_oc4 / diagnostic_suite)。
./pivot/p_3.md:2030:- 与 KPR 边界(D3: 76%增益来自多人"找哪个")要划清——这版治"身份污染"非"找哪个"。
./pivot/p_3.md:2034:- **[119] 噪声注入模板**: 车牌自动关联车辆当遮挡注入(外部免标注数据→训练分布→测试干净)=完美获胜配方, 但它只 show 没 explain why。可借结构 + 补"why"(occluder-ID 解耦)。
./pivot/p_3.md:2045:**领域(167篇)+ 你自己的 D4 诊断 + 获胜配方 三方收敛到同一个角度: 同框入侵身份泄漏的 source-separation(非补全)。** 这是 reid-paper 项目最强活口, 也是全领域空白, 且自带打 wall-2 的对照 + 一晚的 kill-switch。下一步: 核对"主要人物归属"当年判死理由 → 不撞则跑探针 → 建 donor-leakage 反事实一致性方法。
./pivot/p_3.md:2120:3. **SMPL 数据/提取=症结**：单图低分辨率遮挡 crop 上 ROMP 的 10-d 体型 β 被相机/姿态噪声主导、与细粒度身份无关 + 主动稀释外观。
./pivot/p_3.md:2177:最该回到：**遮挡 ReID 的“同框入侵身份泄漏 / source separation”问题**，不是回到旧的 pose / visibility / completion。
./pivot/p_3.md:2183:- 遮挡方向不能再讲“缺失补全”，要重定义为：遮挡不是少信息，而是**别人的身份信息污染 target embedding**。
./pivot/p_3.md:2184:- 这能自然长出方法：训练期合成已知 donor identity 的人遮挡、压制 donor-ID 可预测性、保持 target identity 一致；推理期不加任何外部输入。
./pivot/p_3.md:2185:- 关键 kill-switch 很硬：冻结强 Swin embedding，训练 probe 预测遮挡者 / donor ID。若 probe 显著高于随机，且在人遮挡 split 高、物体遮挡/Market 低，这就是 B 类方法稿需要的隐藏变量。

./pivot/p_3.md:2217:- 遮挡方向不能再讲“缺失补全”，要重定义为：遮挡不是少信息，而是**别人的身份信息污染 target embedding**。
./pivot/p_3.md:2218:- 这能自然长出方法：训练期合成已知 donor identity 的人遮挡、压制 donor-ID 可预测性、保持 target identity 一致；推理期不加任何外部输入。
./pivot/p_3.md:2219:- 关键 kill-switch 很硬：冻结强 Swin embedding，训练 probe 预测遮挡者 / donor ID。若 probe 显著高于随机，且在人遮挡 split 高、物体遮挡/Market 低，这就是 B 类方法稿需要的隐藏变量。
./analyses/deep_20.txt:7:2. 重定义动作：他们把旧问题“学习域不变特征”改写成“在保持域多样性的同时构造域平衡”。关键词是 biased source domains、domain balance、domain diversity、asynchronous training、divide and conquer、synergy perception。核心话术是，简单重采样会丢掉大域知识，简单联合训练会被规模偏置拖垮，所以需要一种不丢信息的平衡学习范式。
./analyses/deep_20.txt:65:1. 触发观察：遮挡 ReID 里车辆遮挡很常见，论文说 Occluded-Duke query 中 vehicle-induced occlusion 占比超过 40%，但车辆图像通常被当成无关噪声丢掉。作者反过来观察到，车辆图像有真实纹理、颜色、视角和相机偏置，而且很容易从车牌系统收集。
./analyses/deep_20.txt:67:2. 重定义动作：这是最值得学的一篇。它把“车辆是噪声”改写成“车辆是有结构的正向噪声”。关键词是 positive noise、positive-incentive noise、structured cross-domain noise、data-centric perspective、vehicle data as valuable training resource、without manual annotations。旧问题是遮挡建模，新问题是如何用真实跨域干扰物降低遮挡识别的不确定性。
./analyses/deep_16.txt:30:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡从“需要鲁棒特征”改写成“特征空间里的结构化污染，需要反变换恢复干净身份表征”。关键词是 feature-level inpainting、inverse transform、clean identity-preserving embedding、de-occlusion、centroid-guided pruning。
./analyses/deep_16.txt:31:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果接受“遮挡是特征污染”，扩散式去噪补全就很自然。DDO 用冻结 ViT 的干净特征作监督，把遮挡特征恢复成干净特征。HRR 则利用身份中心先筛候选，再做局部重排序。不过 HRR 依赖闭集身份结构，协议风险比 DDO 大。
./analyses/deep_16.txt:32:4. 证据闭环：证据比较直接。可视化显示 DDO 把注意力从白墙、遮挡物拉回衣服、脸和可见身体；MSE、余弦误差和 SSIM 显示补全后特征更接近干净特征；DDO 插到 TransReID 和 Pass-ViT 也有增益。HRR 的证据更复杂，Occluded-Duke 上 mAP 从 81.8 到 90.6，但 Occluded-ReID 上会从 92.3 降到 90.1，作者也承认图库身份样本少或重遮挡时中心会偏。

./analyses/deep_23.txt:6:3. **机制怎么长出来**：RPE 从真实遮挡分布自然推出，下半身优先擦除。DMPA 从“语义缺失”推出，在文本 prompt 上做双重 mask，用文本到文本对比让身份文本原型对缺失语义稳定。MDO 从“增强后分布不一致”推出，在特征空间做擦除、噪声、局部替换，再用两步对抗优化逼原始和扰动特征一致。RPE 和重定义绑定最紧，DMPA 次之，MDO 更像通用鲁棒性补强。

./pivot/novelty_gopl.md:14:我们要做 ReID 方法 GOPL(Geometry-Ordered Positive Learning)。重定义: 大家以为跨视角/遮挡 ReID 难在'特征对齐不够', 其实是'正样本关系粒度错了'——ReID 训练把同一 ID 的所有 pair 当等价正样本, 但两张图**共同可观测的人体表面**可能几乎不重叠, 把'同一身份'标签变成过强监督。机制: 用 SMPL mesh 投影算 pairwise 共同可见表面 overlap(IoU), 高overlap正边早期强拉近、低overlap正边延迟/弱约束/桥接, sampler 建 geometry-positive graph。SMPL 只当 pair-reliability meter, 不是身份特征也不是对齐模块。

./pivot/novelty_gopl.md:38:web search: "GiLt" "person re-identification" part-based representations robust to occlusions
./analyses/deep_25.txt:65:1. **触发观察**：遮挡 ReID 里 pose、human parsing 和 occlusion augmentation 都常见，但作者指出两个更具体的失败场景：极端物体遮挡下，局部 pose 错误会污染全局特征；非目标行人遮挡下，遮挡者也有人体骨架，pose 无法区分目标和遮挡行人。作者还用了一个接近人类识别的观察：行人互相遮挡时，背包、伞、衣服纹理这类 distinctive appearance 往往决定识别。
./analyses/deep_25.txt:67:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。
./analyses/deep_25.txt:71:4. **证据闭环**：消融很干净。Occluded-Duke 上 baseline 是 59.4 rank-1、49.7 mAP；加 MFE 到 62.2、52.4；加 PPM 到 67.3、56.1；MFE+PPM 到 68.9、57.0；完整 TTPM 到 73.4、63.4。Occluded-REID 上从 72.1、67.6 到 86.8、82.2。TAD 还拆 CEL 和 TEL，证明上下文和纹理都贡献。可视化上，PPM 热图在极端遮挡下更集中到目标有效区域；检索图展示非目标行人遮挡时 TAD 能帮忙找回；失败案例也说明当目标和遮挡者纹理高度相似时仍会失败，这反而让机制边界更可信。
./pivot/clean/p_2.txt:40:重定义：大家以为遮挡/跨视角失败是“可见区域不够”，其实是 **身份判别权重被少数表面错误垄断**。某些表面在训练集中稳定、显著、容易学，比如裤腿、鞋、背包、上衣纹理；但在航拍-地面、遮挡、VI 或换衣条件下，这些表面并不稳定。问题不是“找可见区域”，而是“估计并打断 surface ownership shortcut”。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:21:2. **重定义动作**：视频 ReID 被改写成“2D 视频外观不足，需要 3D 几何和 shape 作为稳定身份线索”。关键词是 `frame-level feature quality`、`3D modality`、`geometric information`、`shape cues`、`feature inconsistency`、`appearance confusion`。先例上，3D ReID 已有 OGNet 这类图像级 3D 尝试，但本文把位置卡在 video ReID 和 2D-3D 融合策略上。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.04569?utm_source=openai))
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:25:4. **证据闭环**：它的证据链较完整。组件 ablation 显示 SSTI 对 appearance confusion 有贡献，CMF 对 frame-level feature 贡献更大；fusion strategy 对比证明不是随便 concat 3D 就行；SSTI 和 GRU/self-attention、空间/时间单流等变体对比证明“空间和时间 shape 交互”必要；t-SNE、Grad-CAM、hard occlusion feature map 展示模型确实更关注目标区域。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:31:1. **触发观察**：作者观察到 visible 和 infrared 的频谱分布不同，IR 更集中在低频，visible 有更多中高频细节。现有方法要么做图像生成，要么做特征空间对齐；已有频域 VI-ReID 如 FDNM 已提出频域差异，但大多把频率当成一个统一处理工具。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.02162?utm_source=openai))
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:45:2. **重定义动作**：它把换衣 ReID 从“找更强的外观/形状特征”改成“让衣服线索失效，并强迫模型使用非衣服的人体语义”。关键词是 `visual shielding`、`clothing-irrelevant feature`、`human semantic attention`、`potential consistency`。语义像素替换已有先例，SAVS 的差异是把语义前景注意力和衣服屏蔽一致性联合起来。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.08387?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.11522?utm_source=openai))
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:53:**5. A Semantic-guided occlusion simulation based local feature semantic expansion network**
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:55:1. **触发观察**：遮挡不是随机黑块，真实遮挡物有形状、有语义，而且经常遮住关键身份区域。另一个观察是 CNN 深层局部特征容易盯住单个中心或背景冗余语义，导致局部语义表达不足。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:57:2. **重定义动作**：它把遮挡 ReID 从“增强遮挡鲁棒性”改成两个新问题：遮挡是语义干扰，不是随机缺失；关键局部区域需要邻近语义扩展，不是孤立地看。关键词是 `semantic-guided occlusion simulation`、`semantic differential features`、`local feature semantic expansion`、`semantic relevance`、`semantic continuity`。它和 FED 这类遮挡特征擦除/扩散方法相比，切入点更偏“如何构造更像真实干扰的训练样本”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.08740?utm_source=openai))
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:67:1. **触发观察**：3D skeleton ReID 已经出现手工特征、序列模型、图模型、监督/自监督/无监督等多条线，但缺少系统综述。传统外观 ReID 依赖 RGB、衣服、人脸，存在隐私、视角、背景和外观变化问题；skeleton 则有轻量、隐私友好、抗背景和视角变化的优势。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.15296?utm_source=openai))
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:195:2. 重定义动作：它把 UDA 从“目标域伪标签怎么修”改成“先用多源域学一个更好的、轻量的、可泛化初始化，再进入目标域伪标签学习”。关键词是 lightweight multi-source domain adaptation、self-paced meta-learning、style uncertainty augment、whole-part feature、edge deployment。它还把效率从附加指标提升成问题定义的一部分。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:363:1. 触发观察：作者抓的是 Transformer 遮挡 ReID 的通病，patch 被近似一视同仁处理，没有量化不同 patch 对身份的贡献，也缺少足够强的局部细节抽取能力。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:462:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡从“需要鲁棒特征”改写成“特征空间里的结构化污染，需要反变换恢复干净身份表征”。关键词是 feature-level inpainting、inverse transform、clean identity-preserving embedding、de-occlusion、centroid-guided pruning。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:463:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果接受“遮挡是特征污染”，扩散式去噪补全就很自然。DDO 用冻结 ViT 的干净特征作监督，把遮挡特征恢复成干净特征。HRR 则利用身份中心先筛候选，再做局部重排序。不过 HRR 依赖闭集身份结构，协议风险比 DDO 大。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:464:4. 证据闭环：证据比较直接。可视化显示 DDO 把注意力从白墙、遮挡物拉回衣服、脸和可见身体；MSE、余弦误差和 SSIM 显示补全后特征更接近干净特征；DDO 插到 TransReID 和 Pass-ViT 也有增益。HRR 的证据更复杂，Occluded-Duke 上 mAP 从 81.8 到 90.6，但 Occluded-ReID 上会从 92.3 降到 90.1，作者也承认图库身份样本少或重遮挡时中心会偏。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:735:1. **触发观察**：作者抓住遮挡 ReID 里两种局部特征方案的失败。人工水平切块会因为尺度和姿态导致部位错位；姿态估计能缓解错位，但对噪声敏感，还会忽略包、伞、手提物这类非身体但有身份辨识度的线索，而且引入额外模型复杂度。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:759:1. **触发观察**：作者抓住换衣 ReID 的两个常见依赖：一类靠姿态、轮廓、步态等生物线索，遇到遮挡、低光、质量差会不稳；一类做衣服与身份解耦，可能引入额外计算、失真和训练不稳定。另一个关键观察是 ViT 不同层的 attention map 关注内容明显不同，但很多 ReID 模型只用最后一层。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:782:2. 重定义动作：他们把旧问题“学习域不变特征”改写成“在保持域多样性的同时构造域平衡”。关键词是 biased source domains、domain balance、domain diversity、asynchronous training、divide and conquer、synergy perception。核心话术是，简单重采样会丢掉大域知识，简单联合训练会被规模偏置拖垮，所以需要一种不丢信息的平衡学习范式。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:840:1. 触发观察：遮挡 ReID 里车辆遮挡很常见，论文说 Occluded-Duke query 中 vehicle-induced occlusion 占比超过 40%，但车辆图像通常被当成无关噪声丢掉。作者反过来观察到，车辆图像有真实纹理、颜色、视角和相机偏置，而且很容易从车牌系统收集。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:842:2. 重定义动作：这是最值得学的一篇。它把“车辆是噪声”改写成“车辆是有结构的正向噪声”。关键词是 positive noise、positive-incentive noise、structured cross-domain noise、data-centric perspective、vehicle data as valuable training resource、without manual annotations。旧问题是遮挡建模，新问题是如何用真实跨域干扰物降低遮挡识别的不确定性。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:865:5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：买账点主要是视角和任务定义，不是图注意力或 KL 本身多新。它把“遮挡 VI-ReID”讲成一个尚未充分处理的交叉问题：缺失身份线索和跨模态错位同时发生。因此模块虽然常见，但被一个清楚的问题链条串住了。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:907:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何在输出特征上找可见区域”改成“如何在中间层阻断遮挡信息扩散，并用骨架区域补足关键点之间的外观”。关键词是 `occlusion information diffusion`、`decouple pedestrian features and occlusion information`、`visible appearance region attention`、`skeletal area modeling`、`skeleton-modulated cross-attention`。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:919:2. **重定义动作**：他们把隐私保护从“改造真实图片”改成“用新合成 ID 替换真实 ID，同时保留 ReID 训练效用”。关键词是 `new IDs`、`anonymizing diffusion model`、`privacy-compliant benchmarks`、`ID separation degree`、`privacy-utility trade-off`、`eliminate at source`。这一步把任务从图像脱敏变成了数据集替代。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1015:2. **重定义动作**：它把遮挡 ReID 从“局部特征缺失”改写成“遮挡分布不匹配加跨模态语义退化加增强特征分布不一致”。关键词是 `occlusion distribution mismatch`、`semantic degradation`、`prompt-distribution synergy`、`region-prioritized erasure`。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1016:3. **机制怎么长出来**：RPE 从真实遮挡分布自然推出，下半身优先擦除。DMPA 从“语义缺失”推出，在文本 prompt 上做双重 mask，用文本到文本对比让身份文本原型对缺失语义稳定。MDO 从“增强后分布不一致”推出，在特征空间做擦除、噪声、局部替换，再用两步对抗优化逼原始和扰动特征一致。RPE 和重定义绑定最紧，DMPA 次之，MDO 更像通用鲁棒性补强。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1115:我主要依据本地 PDF 全文方法和消融页阅读，另外核对了 ScRL 和 FedSTIL 的 arXiv 页面，以及弱监督文本 ReID 相关背景 CPCL 页面：ScRL arXiv([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.17952?utm_source=openai))、FedSTIL arXiv([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.11759?utm_source=openai))、CPCL arXiv([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.10011?utm_source=openai))。

./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1251:2. 重定义动作：这篇不是方法论文，它把 UAV-ReID 从“普通 ReID 的一个数据集变体”重定义成独立问题域。关键词是 aerial perspective、dynamic background、motion blur、resource constraints、aerial-ground gap、privacy concerns。
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1433:5. reviewer 为什么买账：卖的是“用反度量困难样本训练泛化能力”的视角。机制有些堆，但 perturbation 到 defense 的逻辑很顺。需要注意，ReID 对抗攻击早有先例，例如 MUAP 这类工作已经证明 ReID 排序容易被扰动攻击，APD 的新意在于把攻击思想转成 DG 训练样本和语义防御。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.14184?utm_source=openai))
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1437:1. 触发观察：ReID 缺标注数据，渲染数据贵且粗糙，GAN 增广容易伪影和模式坍塌；扩散模型图像质量高，但用于 ReID 时最要命的是换姿态后身份一致性不稳。PIDM 这类扩散人像生成是直接先例。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.12500?utm_source=openai))
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1445:1. 触发观察：CLIP-ReID 类方法已经很强，但它依赖整体语义提示，在遮挡和细粒度相似行人上容易只看主特征，漏掉头发、包、衣服细节。CLIP-ReID 与 CoOp 是它的直接技术背景。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.13977?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.01134?utm_source=openai))
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1457:5. reviewer 为什么买账：卖的是视角和形式化机制。它不是说“我又对齐了一下”，而是说“过度对齐会损失有用细节”。近邻工作里 SGIEL 已经用正交子空间和形状擦除来挖 shared cue，LUPI 也用中间域补信息，所以 BDLF 的边界在“base/detail 相关性分解，而非额外生成或形状特权信息”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.04205?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.09348?utm_source=openai))
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1461:1. 触发观察：2D ReID 受视角和背景影响大，3D ReID 理应解决，但已有 3D 方法多是把纹理贴到点云上做分类，实际没有充分利用 3D 的视角归一化，也没用好高分辨率纹理。3DInvarReID 等说明 3D 形状线已经存在。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.10658?utm_source=openai))
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1464:4. 证据闭环：它必须证明两件事：UVTexture 的注意力比 2D 图像更对齐、更少受背景和视角影响；IAS 不只是好看，还能提升重排序结果。论文用 2D/UVTexture 激活图对比、双流对比、KNN/属性/解释重排消融和 aerial-ground 数据集结果形成闭环。AG-ReID.v2 这类跨空地数据也说明视角差异是真问题。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.02634?utm_source=openai))
./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1524:1. 触发观察：作者先抓住两个失败现象。传统遮挡 ReID 依赖姿态、人体解析、attention 或遮挡增广，但它们都只看视觉，容易把遮挡物也当成身份特征。CLIP-ReID 引入语言后仍然不够，因为 prompt 是全局粗粒度的，文本主要用于对比监督，并没有直接指导模型区分“人、可见属性、遮挡物”。

./reviews/deep_25.md:14095:1. **触发观察**：遮挡 ReID 里 pose、human parsing 和 occlusion augmentation 都常见，但作者指出两个更具体的失败场景：极端物体遮挡下，局部 pose 错误会污染全局特征；非目标行人遮挡下，遮挡者也有人体骨架，pose 无法区分目标和遮挡行人。作者还用了一个接近人类识别的观察：行人互相遮挡时，背包、伞、衣服纹理这类 distinctive appearance 往往决定识别。
./reviews/deep_25.md:14097:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。
./reviews/deep_25.md:14101:4. **证据闭环**：消融很干净。Occluded-Duke 上 baseline 是 59.4 rank-1、49.7 mAP；加 MFE 到 62.2、52.4；加 PPM 到 67.3、56.1；MFE+PPM 到 68.9、57.0；完整 TTPM 到 73.4、63.4。Occluded-REID 上从 72.1、67.6 到 86.8、82.2。TAD 还拆 CEL 和 TEL，证明上下文和纹理都贡献。可视化上，PPM 热图在极端遮挡下更集中到目标有效区域；检索图展示非目标行人遮挡时 TAD 能帮忙找回；失败案例也说明当目标和遮挡者纹理高度相似时仍会失败，这反而让机制边界更可信。

./pivot/clean/p_3.txt:27:- 遮挡方向不能再讲“缺失补全”，要重定义为：遮挡不是少信息，而是**别人的身份信息污染 target embedding**。

./pivot/clean/p_3.txt:29:- 关键 kill-switch 很硬：冻结强 Swin embedding，训练 probe 预测遮挡者 / donor ID。若 probe 显著高于随机，且在人遮挡 split 高、物体遮挡/Market 低，这就是 B 类方法稿需要的隐藏变量。

./analyses/deep_3.txt:17:5. reviewer 为什么买账：卖的是“用反度量困难样本训练泛化能力”的视角。机制有些堆，但 perturbation 到 defense 的逻辑很顺。需要注意，ReID 对抗攻击早有先例，例如 MUAP 这类工作已经证明 ReID 排序容易被扰动攻击，APD 的新意在于把攻击思想转成 DG 训练样本和语义防御。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.14184?utm_source=openai))
./analyses/deep_3.txt:21:1. 触发观察：ReID 缺标注数据，渲染数据贵且粗糙，GAN 增广容易伪影和模式坍塌；扩散模型图像质量高，但用于 ReID 时最要命的是换姿态后身份一致性不稳。PIDM 这类扩散人像生成是直接先例。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.12500?utm_source=openai))
./analyses/deep_3.txt:29:1. 触发观察：CLIP-ReID 类方法已经很强，但它依赖整体语义提示，在遮挡和细粒度相似行人上容易只看主特征，漏掉头发、包、衣服细节。CLIP-ReID 与 CoOp 是它的直接技术背景。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.13977?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.01134?utm_source=openai))
./analyses/deep_3.txt:41:5. reviewer 为什么买账：卖的是视角和形式化机制。它不是说“我又对齐了一下”，而是说“过度对齐会损失有用细节”。近邻工作里 SGIEL 已经用正交子空间和形状擦除来挖 shared cue，LUPI 也用中间域补信息，所以 BDLF 的边界在“base/detail 相关性分解，而非额外生成或形状特权信息”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.04205?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.09348?utm_source=openai))
./analyses/deep_3.txt:45:1. 触发观察：2D ReID 受视角和背景影响大，3D ReID 理应解决，但已有 3D 方法多是把纹理贴到点云上做分类，实际没有充分利用 3D 的视角归一化，也没用好高分辨率纹理。3DInvarReID 等说明 3D 形状线已经存在。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.10658?utm_source=openai))

./validate/clean/v_2.txt:17:- vs **OT-ReID / CM-EMD**：CM-EMD 是用最优传输做跨模态分布对齐，核心是 transport cost 和 intra-identity variation weighting；B 不能写成“更好的 OT”，而要强调**不求对齐/搬运，而是接受航拍证据欠定，用非对称覆盖打分**。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.01675?utm_source=openai))
./validate/clean/v_2.txt:18:- vs **AGPReID 红海**：VDT 是 view-related/view-unrelated decoupling，GSAlign 是 TPS 几何 warp + visibility mask，SeCap 是 prompt recalibration + local refinement，DTST 是 token selection。B 必须避开“几何/可见性/局部选择”，把 SMPL 只用作诊断物理欠定度，不作为主模块。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.14513?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22268?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.06965?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.00433?utm_source=openai))

./validate/v_2.md:7013:validate/v_3.md:1723:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

./validate/v_2.md:12861:validate/v_3.md:4047:../litreview/reviews/lit_15.md:4238:切开点：最像 PDA，但 PDA 的“包含关系”来自文本和图像的抽象层级；我们这里的包含关系来自航拍低清、俯视、遮挡下的 3D 可见性。它也不同于普通跨视角对齐，不是假设两个视角应映射到同一点，而是假设航拍观测对应一个由 SMPL 可见部位和投影不确定性定义的身份范围。  
./validate/v_2.md:12864:validate/v_3.md:4052:../litreview/reviews/lit_15.md:4248:切开点：最像 mixed-degradation ReID，但那篇是天气退化的混合；我们做的是行人跨平台观测混合，变量是高度、俯仰角、分辨率、遮挡和地面视角。关键不是再做一个鲁棒增强，而是定义“混合观测 ReID”并证明身份邻域结构在混合观测下被扭曲，普通域对齐只能修中心偏移，修不了拓扑。  
./validate/v_2.md:12865:validate/v_3.md:4053:../litreview/reviews/lit_15.md:4249:cheap kill-switch：冻结 SOLIDER，在航拍地面数据上按高度、分辨率、视角、遮挡分桶，计算同身份邻域保持率和跨桶检索掉点。若只是整体中心偏移，简单白化或域对齐就能恢复，那这个方向不够强。

./validate/v_2.md:14070:validate/v_2.md:12327:- **#2 OVP-Mem 训练完成: 🎯 final 50.11 mAP(R1 54.93)@ep60, baseline 32.48 → +17.6, 达 VDT SOTA~50!** 轨迹 28.35→36.32→39.18→43.83→48.76→50.11。在 resnet50 BoT(弱于 VDT 的 ViT)上做到 SOTA 量级。★**方向铁证金矿**(代码双审无泄漏: 原型训练期/eval 测试 pid 不相交; +17.6 达 SOTA 待用户多 seed 复核)。但 OVP 撞 CMPC → **headline 走 OVLI**(见下), OVP 降为强 ablation。
./validate/v_2.md:14462:- vs **probabilistic embedding / uncertainty ReID**：PCME 用概率分布处理图文一对多对应，DUL/ReID uncertainty 用后验/先验高斯建模样本不确定性；它们不是 cross-view 物理方向的包含关系。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.05068?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.08785))
./validate/v_2.md:14463:- vs **OT-ReID / CM-EMD**：CM-EMD 是用最优传输做跨模态分布对齐，核心是 transport cost 和 intra-identity variation weighting；B 不能写成“更好的 OT”，而要强调**不求对齐/搬运，而是接受航拍证据欠定，用非对称覆盖打分**。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.01675?utm_source=openai))
./validate/v_2.md:14464:- vs **AGPReID 红海**：VDT 是 view-related/view-unrelated decoupling，GSAlign 是 TPS 几何 warp + visibility mask，SeCap 是 prompt recalibration + local refinement，DTST 是 token selection。B 必须避开“几何/可见性/局部选择”，把 SMPL 只用作诊断物理欠定度，不作为主模块。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.14513?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22268?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.06965?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.00433?utm_source=openai))
./validate/v_2.md:14465:- vs **cross-resolution ReID**：PS-HRNet/RFD 这类线主要做恢复、变换或 resolution-invariant feature；B 的说法应是“不幻想补齐不可见细节，而是显式表达候选身份范围”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.11722?utm_source=openai))
./validate/v_2.md:14516:- vs **probabilistic embedding / uncertainty ReID**：PCME 用概率分布处理图文一对多对应，DUL/ReID uncertainty 用后验/先验高斯建模样本不确定性；它们不是 cross-view 物理方向的包含关系。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.05068?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.08785))
./validate/v_2.md:14517:- vs **OT-ReID / CM-EMD**：CM-EMD 是用最优传输做跨模态分布对齐，核心是 transport cost 和 intra-identity variation weighting；B 不能写成“更好的 OT”，而要强调**不求对齐/搬运，而是接受航拍证据欠定，用非对称覆盖打分**。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.01675?utm_source=openai))

./validate/v_3.md:760:./reviews/deep_23.md:8955:3. **机制怎么长出来**：RPE 从真实遮挡分布自然推出，下半身优先擦除。DMPA 从“语义缺失”推出，在文本 prompt 上做双重 mask，用文本到文本对比让身份文本原型对缺失语义稳定。MDO 从“增强后分布不一致”推出，在特征空间做擦除、噪声、局部替换，再用两步对抗优化逼原始和扰动特征一致。RPE 和重定义绑定最紧，DMPA 次之，MDO 更像通用鲁棒性补强。

./validate/v_3.md:1723:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",
./validate/v_3.md:1761:../codex_review_raw.txt:4966:./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

./validate/v_3.md:1886:./reviews/deep_25.md:14095:1. **触发观察**：遮挡 ReID 里 pose、human parsing 和 occlusion augmentation 都常见，但作者指出两个更具体的失败场景：极端物体遮挡下，局部 pose 错误会污染全局特征；非目标行人遮挡下，遮挡者也有人体骨架，pose 无法区分目标和遮挡行人。作者还用了一个接近人类识别的观察：行人互相遮挡时，背包、伞、衣服纹理这类 distinctive appearance 往往决定识别。
./validate/v_3.md:1887:./reviews/deep_25.md:14097:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。
./validate/v_3.md:1889:./reviews/deep_25.md:14101:4. **证据闭环**：消融很干净。Occluded-Duke 上 baseline 是 59.4 rank-1、49.7 mAP；加 MFE 到 62.2、52.4；加 PPM 到 67.3、56.1；MFE+PPM 到 68.9、57.0；完整 TTPM 到 73.4、63.4。Occluded-REID 上从 72.1、67.6 到 86.8、82.2。TAD 还拆 CEL 和 TEL，证明上下文和纹理都贡献。可视化上，PPM 热图在极端遮挡下更集中到目标有效区域；检索图展示非目标行人遮挡时 TAD 能帮忙找回；失败案例也说明当目标和遮挡者纹理高度相似时仍会失败，这反而让机制边界更可信。
