./validate/v_3.md:3004:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1457:5. reviewer 为什么买账：卖的是视角和形式化机制。它不是说“我又对齐了一下”，而是说“过度对齐会损失有用细节”。近邻工作里 SGIEL 已经用正交子空间和形状擦除来挖 shared cue，LUPI 也用中间域补信息，所以 BDLF 的边界在“base/detail 相关性分解，而非额外生成或形状特权信息”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.04205?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2209.09348?utm_source=openai))
./validate/v_3.md:3006:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1464:4. 证据闭环：它必须证明两件事：UVTexture 的注意力比 2D 图像更对齐、更少受背景和视角影响；IAS 不只是好看，还能提升重排序结果。论文用 2D/UVTexture 激活图对比、双流对比、KNN/属性/解释重排消融和 aerial-ground 数据集结果形成闭环。AG-ReID.v2 这类跨空地数据也说明视角差异是真问题。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.02634?utm_source=openai))
./validate/v_3.md:3018:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1524:1. 触发观察：作者先抓住两个失败现象。传统遮挡 ReID 依赖姿态、人体解析、attention 或遮挡增广，但它们都只看视觉，容易把遮挡物也当成身份特征。CLIP-ReID 引入语言后仍然不够，因为 prompt 是全局粗粒度的，文本主要用于对比监督，并没有直接指导模型区分“人、可见属性、遮挡物”。
./validate/v_3.md:3019:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1526:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡问题重定义成 language-guided noise filtering，而不是简单的 visible part matching。更关键的是，他们把图像内容拆成三个语义类别：主体身份、可见属性、遮挡物。关键词是 categorical attention、fine-grained prompt、occlusion-aware prompt、subject token、attribute token、context token。这个重定义把“遮挡”从一个空间缺失问题变成了一个语义分类和噪声过滤问题。
./validate/v_3.md:3031:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1576:2. 重定义动作：它把 ReID 从“所有查询都用同一个特征管线”改写成“检索应该根据查询难度动态分配计算资源”。关键词是 coarse-to-fine retrieval、query difficulty、early exit、easy query、hard query、adaptive resource allocation。
./validate/v_3.md:3068:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1742:1. 触发观察：视频 ReID 的全局特征会混入遮挡、检测框错误、背景；局部 part 特征又有对齐问题。硬条带太粗，外部 pose/parsing 计算重，还会把背包、手提包这类有身份价值的上下文当背景。
./validate/v_3.md:4044:../litreview/reviews/lit_15.md:4226:创新类型是新设定细化加工程组合。gap 是遮挡 ReID 里随机擦除和真实遮挡分布不一致，且 CLIP prompt 对缺失语义不稳。它用下半身优先擦除、双 masked prompt、多分支分布对齐来补。story 是“训练遮挡必须像真实遮挡，文本 prompt 也要学会缺词时仍保持身份语义”。
./validate/v_3.md:4047:../litreview/reviews/lit_15.md:4238:切开点：最像 PDA，但 PDA 的“包含关系”来自文本和图像的抽象层级；我们这里的包含关系来自航拍低清、俯视、遮挡下的 3D 可见性。它也不同于普通跨视角对齐，不是假设两个视角应映射到同一点，而是假设航拍观测对应一个由 SMPL 可见部位和投影不确定性定义的身份范围。  
./validate/v_3.md:4052:../litreview/reviews/lit_15.md:4248:切开点：最像 mixed-degradation ReID，但那篇是天气退化的混合；我们做的是行人跨平台观测混合，变量是高度、俯仰角、分辨率、遮挡和地面视角。关键不是再做一个鲁棒增强，而是定义“混合观测 ReID”并证明身份邻域结构在混合观测下被扭曲，普通域对齐只能修中心偏移，修不了拓扑。  
./validate/v_3.md:4053:../litreview/reviews/lit_15.md:4249:cheap kill-switch：冻结 SOLIDER，在航拍地面数据上按高度、分辨率、视角、遮挡分桶，计算同身份邻域保持率和跨桶检索掉点。若只是整体中心偏移，简单白化或域对齐就能恢复，那这个方向不够强。

./reassess/r_3.md:16:- **死2(刚)**: GOPL'正样本关系粒度错了'(用 SMPL 共同可见人体表面 overlap 当 same-ID 正边可靠性)。冻结最强 occluded_duke ckpt(exp255, sanity mAP73.05≈训练73.2)测: cosine 距离确实弱负相关 overlap(rho≈-0.13)但: D5 随机关节子集打平(-0.1294≈真-0.1273)、cov2d 控住可见关节数后归零(+0.0145)、#vis 关节数 baseline 反而更强(-0.1321)、相机对(视角差)解释方差 eta²0.062 比 SMPL cov 0.018 还大、cov3d(3D自遮挡)没明显强于 cov2d → 隐藏变量是'遮挡越重越难'(occlusion-count)不是'共同可见表面', SMPL 几何=VPM/QPM/occlusion-count 换名无独特信号。
./reassess/r_3.md:18:**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。
./reassess/r_3.md:23:角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。
./reassess/r_3.md:25:我会先按仓库接手规则读最新结果/决策/story，再联网查 TTPM、non-target pedestrian occlusion 和 donor/occluder 身份泄漏相关工作，最后给一个能直接判生死的低成本实验设计。当前环境是只读沙箱，所以我不能落盘设计文档或启动训练，只能做审查与方案输出。

./reassess/r_3.md:2218:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2015:Occluded-Duke 的遮挡**大比例是"另一个行人"而非物体**。全领域(167篇)把遮挡当"信息缺失→补全(completion/pose/part/CLIP)"。**真正失败不是缺信息, 而是 target embedding 被遮挡那个人的身份污染**——一个 distractor identity 泄漏进来。这是 source-separation 问题, 与全场"补全"范式正交。**没有一篇这么做。**

./reassess/r_3.md:2220:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2019:- **机制链**: ①训练分布改动——把**已知身份**的另一行人 crop 合成贴到目标(入侵者 ID 仅训练期可得=外部信息源); ②对 embedding 做入侵身份的**对抗/对比抑制**(不是 gate——occluder-gate 是墙); ③可选 target↔自身 holistic 一致性。
./reassess/r_3.md:2221:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_3.md:2020:- **★"为什么有效"中间变量**: **入侵者身份探针**——训一个 probe 从 target embedding 预测同框入侵者 ID 的准确率=泄漏量。baseline 泄漏高, 方法压到随机, 且泄漏下降与 mAP 增益相关。

./reassess/r_3.md:2310:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_16.md:7690:4. 证据闭环：证据比较直接。可视化显示 DDO 把注意力从白墙、遮挡物拉回衣服、脸和可见身体；MSE、余弦误差和 SSIM 显示补全后特征更接近干净特征；DDO 插到 TransReID 和 Pass-ViT 也有增益。HRR 的证据更复杂，Occluded-Duke 上 mAP 从 81.8 到 90.6，但 Occluded-ReID 上会从 92.3 降到 90.1，作者也承认图库身份样本少或重遮挡时中心会偏。
./reassess/r_3.md:2331:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/clean/p_2.txt:40:重定义：大家以为遮挡/跨视角失败是“可见区域不够”，其实是 **身份判别权重被少数表面错误垄断**。某些表面在训练集中稳定、显著、容易学，比如裤腿、鞋、背包、上衣纹理；但在航拍-地面、遮挡、VI 或换衣条件下，这些表面并不稳定。问题不是“找可见区域”，而是“估计并打断 surface ownership shortcut”。

./reassess/r_3.md:2358:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp330_compositional_dro/design.md:6:- **为何这个能逃过"训练吸收"死法（结构性，非侥幸）**：保留的 (occluder类 × 身体部位) 组合**按构造从未进训练分布**，所以训练模型**没有可隐式吸收的结构**——这正是 burstiness 等死掉的失败模式（它们重新提取训练模型早见过的结构）。这个 bet 专门不犯这个错。
./reassess/r_3.md:2359:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/exp330_compositional_dro/design.md:9:ReID 模型在见过的遮挡组合上学到的是**occluder-specific 捷径**（"car 长这样→忽略"），而非**遮挡-不变的 part-identity 证据**。因此对**未见过的 (occluder类×部位) 组合**会崩。**group-DRO**（最小化 worst-group loss over occluder×part cells，而非平均 loss）逼模型学组合-不变的证据 → 在 held-out 组合上 > ERM。

./reassess/r_3.md:2640:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_2.md:13291:1. **触发观察**：作者抓住换衣 ReID 的两个常见依赖：一类靠姿态、轮廓、步态等生物线索，遇到遮挡、低光、质量差会不稳；一类做衣服与身份解耦，可能引入额外计算、失真和训练不稳定。另一个关键观察是 ViT 不同层的 attention map 关注内容明显不同，但很多 ReID 模型只用最后一层。
./reassess/r_3.md:2642:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_2.md:13348:1. **触发观察**：作者抓住遮挡 ReID 里两种局部特征方案的失败。人工水平切块会因为尺度和姿态导致部位错位；姿态估计能缓解错位，但对噪声敏感，还会忽略包、伞、手提物这类非身体但有身份辨识度的线索，而且引入额外模型复杂度。

./reassess/r_3.md:2828:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:701:./validate/clean/v_2.txt:18:- vs **AGPReID 红海**：VDT 是 view-related/view-unrelated decoupling，GSAlign 是 TPS 几何 warp + visibility mask，SeCap 是 prompt recalibration + local refinement，DTST 是 token selection。B 必须避开“几何/可见性/局部选择”，把 SMPL 只用作诊断物理欠定度，不作为主模块。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.14513?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22268?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.06965?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.00433?utm_source=openai))
./reassess/r_3.md:2834:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:728:./analyses/deep_21.txt:55:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何在输出特征上找可见区域”改成“如何在中间层阻断遮挡信息扩散，并用骨架区域补足关键点之间的外观”。关键词是 `occlusion information diffusion`、`decouple pedestrian features and occlusion information`、`visible appearance region attention`、`skeletal area modeling`、`skeleton-modulated cross-attention`。
./reassess/r_3.md:2848:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:835:./analyses/deep_4.txt:53:1. 触发观察：作者先抓住两个失败现象。传统遮挡 ReID 依赖姿态、人体解析、attention 或遮挡增广，但它们都只看视觉，容易把遮挡物也当成身份特征。CLIP-ReID 引入语言后仍然不够，因为 prompt 是全局粗粒度的，文本主要用于对比监督，并没有直接指导模型区分“人、可见属性、遮挡物”。
./reassess/r_3.md:2849:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:836:./analyses/deep_4.txt:55:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡问题重定义成 language-guided noise filtering，而不是简单的 visible part matching。更关键的是，他们把图像内容拆成三个语义类别：主体身份、可见属性、遮挡物。关键词是 categorical attention、fine-grained prompt、occlusion-aware prompt、subject token、attribute token、context token。这个重定义把“遮挡”从一个空间缺失问题变成了一个语义分类和噪声过滤问题。
./reassess/r_3.md:2858:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:855:./analyses/deep_16.txt:32:4. 证据闭环：证据比较直接。可视化显示 DDO 把注意力从白墙、遮挡物拉回衣服、脸和可见身体；MSE、余弦误差和 SSIM 显示补全后特征更接近干净特征；DDO 插到 TransReID 和 Pass-ViT 也有增益。HRR 的证据更复杂，Occluded-Duke 上 mAP 从 81.8 到 90.6，但 Occluded-ReID 上会从 92.3 降到 90.1，作者也承认图库身份样本少或重遮挡时中心会偏。

./reassess/r_3.md:3040:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2269:./validate/v_2.md:7013:validate/v_3.md:1723:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",
./reassess/r_3.md:3041:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:2270:./validate/v_2.md:7014:validate/v_3.md:1761:../codex_review_raw.txt:4966:./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. Treat occluded body regions as \"missing attributes\" and a holistic reference (a pose prototype, a holistic-image feature, or a clean part-feature memory) as the bridge: use cross-attention to compute a (1 − similarity) \"missing-ness\" mask over body parts/channels, inject only the missing content via channel gating + residual term, then run a refinement stage that subtracts content already present/inconsistent with the reference (weighted by reference-similarity) to avoid filling occluded regions with hallucinated or occluder-derived features. This separates \"fill what is missing\" from \"remove what is corrupted/distractor\" in one module, and the whole bridge+compensation apparatus is training-only so it adds zero inference cost — attractive for occluded ReID feature completion that today often hallucinates or copies occluder content.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4148:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/airl_codex_bundle/reviews/codex_1.md:12144:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. ./reassess/r_3.md:4481:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:14:"transfer_to_occluded": "Adapt the VCS \"corrupt-a-parsed-region + feature-consistency loss\" trick to occlusion: use human parsing (or an occluder mask) to identify non-target/occluded regions, synthesize occlusion by replacing those pixels with random pixels sampled from a per-batch pool, then add an L2/MSE alignment loss pulling the corrupted-image feature toward the clean-image feature. This is a training-only, self-supervised occlusion-augmentation regularizer that teaches the backbone to produce features invariant to corrupted/missing regions, without needing extra inference modules or pose at test time. The batch-pool pixel-shuffle (rather than zero/black masking) is the transferable detail — it injects realistic distractor texture instead of constant fills, which better mimics real occluders.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4482:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:21:"mechanism": "TTPM is a ViT + HRNet pipeline with three parts and no occlusion-sample augmentation. A Multi-patch Feature Encoder encodes intra-patch and inter-patch features (re-grouping patches at 2x scale with the cls token). Pose-Patch Mapping (PPM) builds a fine-grained, per-patch positional correspondence between M pose keypoints and N patches via a learned similarity S = gamma*D_M - eta*S_M that combines an affine-extended Mahalanobis distance and affine-extended cosine similarity, gates out low-confidence keypoints by a heatmap-confidence threshold, and selects the argmax-similarity patch per keypoint, thereby down-weighting occluded patches without coarse global pose mapping. A Texture-Aware Decoder (context-extraction MHSA layers + texture-extraction MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4483:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:22:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas for occluded ReID. (1) The pose loss L_p that explicitly minimizes cosine similarity between body-part features and non-human/background features — a cheap regularizer to suppress occluder/background leakage into the identity embedding, applicable to any pose- or part-based occluded model. (2) The texture-distinctiveness decoder channel aimed specifically at non-target PEDESTRIAN occlusion: when the occluder is itself a person, pose/structure cues fail (same skeleton topology), so using texture appearance distinctiveness (via pose-filtered queries cross-attending to contextual features) to push apart target vs distractor-person is a concrete mechanism for the under-addressed person-on-person occlusion case. Also transferable: replacing coarse pose-to-global mapping with a per-keypoint-to-patch confidence-gated argmax correspondence (Mahalanobis+cosine affine similarity) to localize visible regions.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4484:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:30:"transfer_to_occluded": "The dissimilarity-driven dual-stage compensation is directly portable to occlusion. Treat occluded body regions as \"missing attributes\" and a holistic reference (a pose prototype, a holistic-image feature, or a clean part-feature memory) as the bridge: use cross-attention to compute a (1 − similarity) \"missing-ness\" mask over body parts/channels, inject only the missing content via channel gating + residual term, then run a refinement stage that subtracts content already present/inconsistent with the reference (weighted by reference-similarity) to avoid filling occluded regions with hallucinated or occluder-derived features. This separates \"fill what is missing\" from \"remove what is corrupted/distractor\" in one module, and the whole bridge+compensation apparatus is training-only so it adds zero inference cost — attractive for occluded ReID feature completion that today often hallucinates or copies occluder content.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4485:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:37:"mechanism": "CSSA learns pixel-level part labels without any external pose/parsing model: it separates foreground from background by the heuristic that foreground feature maps have stronger L2-norm response, clusters foreground pixels via k-means across a clip (Np=6 fixed clusters), and uses cluster IDs as pseudo-labels to iteratively train a pixel-wise part classifier producing Np+1 confidence maps (parts plus background/occlusion). A CARE module aggregates the whole clip into a denoised video-level embedding (encoder-decoder with an identity cross-entropy bottleneck) and uses its cross-pixel cosine similarity to each frame pixel as a weighted residual gate that amplifies pixels consistent with the dominant identity and suppresses clutter/occluders. SGFA then builds the global feature pair-wise: each semantic part's contribution to the aggregated global vector is weighted by the product of its query and gallery confidence scores, so a part counts only when reliable in both images.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4486:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:39:"transfer_to_occluded": "Apply SGFA's pair-wise reliability product to occluded image ReID: when scoring a probe against each gallery candidate, weight each body part's contribution by the product of the part's visibility/confidence in the probe AND in that candidate (recomputed per pair), rather than a single self-visibility mask. This makes a region count only when it is uncorrupted on both sides — directly addressing the occluded-ReID failure where a part visible in the probe but occluded in the gallery still injects noise. The L2-norm-response foreground heuristic also offers a cheap occluder/background suppressor (occluders/background give weaker feature norm than the target body) usable to derive a soft visibility map without a parsing model.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4488:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:46:"transfer_to_occluded": "This paper IS occluded ReID, so the ideas are native rather than cross-subfield, but two components are concretely reusable in a different occluded pipeline: (1) Categorical learnable queries that explicitly separate \"visible-attribute\" tokens (A*) from \"occluder\" tokens (O*) via cross-attention to patches — i.e., learning an explicit occluder-description token forces the model to model the distractor rather than ignore it, which could be added to a non-CLIP backbone (e.g., Swin/PSG) as an auxiliary \"occluder branch\" whose features are pushed apart from identity features. (2) The entropy-based dynamic fusion: weight each candidate feature stream (global vs. part vs. pose-gated) by the entropy of its own ID-prediction distribution, so low-confidence (heavily occluded) streams are automatically down-weighted at the feature-fusion stage — a drop-in, training-only reliability gate that needs no extra labels and could replace fixed weights in a multi-branch occluded model.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4489:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4491:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:86:"transfer_to_occluded": "Apply the text-level orthogonal-projection disentanglement to occlusion: learn a dual prompt for the OCCLUDER/distractor (e.g. \"a photo of the [X]...[X] occluder\") alongside the ID prompt, then orthogonalize the occluder text feature out of the ID text feature (F_ort = F_id - proj of F_occ onto F_id) and use the purged ID text feature to guide the visual encoder via the non-local SIM. Because the non-local operation aggregates from spatially distant but semantically relevant regions, it is well suited to occluded ReID where visible body parts are scattered far from the occluded/corrupted region — letting the model pull ID evidence from non-adjacent visible patches rather than local self-attention that gets dominated by the occluder. The orthogonalization gives a clean way to subtract a known nuisance direction (occluder appearance) without an auxiliary parser.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4492:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:88:"novel_component": "Disentangling a nuisance factor by vector orthogonal projection in the TEXT embedding space: project the nuisance (clothing) text feature onto the ID text direction and subtract it, purging the nuisance-aligned component of ID features without any auxiliary visual model — a cheap, parser-free disentanglement that generalizes to any named confounder (including occluders)."
./reassess/r_3.md:4493:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4494:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:103:"novel_component": "Reframing an \"unwanted noise\" domain (vehicle images) as positive-incentive noise (π-noise) that, via information-theoretic argument, reduces the recognition task's conditional entropy — and operationalizing it as a cheap, annotation-free occluder source for realistic copy-paste occlusion augmentation rather than treating it as data to discard.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4496:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:119:"transfer_to_occluded": "Repurpose the mask-guided, pose-conditioned diffusion inpainting from \"swap the clothing region\" to \"fill the occluded region\": use a body-segmentation/visibility mask to mark missing or occluder-corrupted body parts, then inpaint them with OpenPose-keypoint-conditioned Stable Diffusion to synthesize plausible body content, generating occlusion-augmented training pairs (or recovered query images). Critically, transfer their two-stage quality gate — admit a recovered region only if its ReID-feature similarity to the clean identity is high and its FID is low — so hallucinated content is filtered before it pollutes training, addressing the chronic risk that completion/inpainting injects identity-inconsistent features in occluded ReID.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4500:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. For occluded ReID this gives a body-structure prior independent of pixel evidence: even when a region is occluded, the reconstructed mesh still provides a body-anchored query, steering attention onto plausible person regions and away from distractor occluders, and the pose/shape-derived reference points act as a soft visibility/structure guide. The SSTI idea of an appearance-independent shape descriptor (from β only) is also a complementary, occlusion-robust feature since estimated body shape is less corrupted by occluders than RGB texture.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4501:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:150:"transfer_to_occluded": "This paper IS occluded ReID, so the whole pipeline is on-domain, but the single most transferable trick is treating occlusion as an explicitly invertible map T in FEATURE space and learning T^-1 with paired clean/occluded-feature supervision — instead of masking/suppressing occluded regions, you generatively reconstruct the clean identity embedding before it reaches the ReID head. Concretely transferable pieces: (1) train a feature-space de-occluder on synthetic occlusion pairs (silhouette-guided background patching + Fourier-domain adaptation to bridge synth-to-real) where the FROZEN ViT clean feature is the ground truth, so no occlusion masks are needed at test time; (2) keep both reconstructed and raw occluded features and fuse them with cross-attention (Q=clean, K/V=occluded) rather than discarding the occluded one — the reconstruction acts as a query that re-attends the raw features toward visible identity regions, which is robust when reconstruction is imperfect; (3) the reconstruction-loss-as-classifier-guidance idea turns an unconditional generative module into an identity-preserving deterministic operator, directly useful for any completion-based occluded-ReID module to avoid hallucinating wrong identities.",
./reassess/r_3.md:4502:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:151:"novel_component": "Formulating occlusion as a deterministic, invertible transform T in deep-feature space and learning its inverse T^-1 via a latent diffusion model supervised by paired clean ViT features — i.e. feature-space inpainting where a reconstruction loss plays the role of classifier guidance, yielding a deterministic identity-preserving de-occluder rather than a stochastic sampler, and crucially requiring no masks/pose/parsing at inference.",

./pivot/p_2.md:701:./validate/clean/v_2.txt:18:- vs **AGPReID 红海**：VDT 是 view-related/view-unrelated decoupling，GSAlign 是 TPS 几何 warp + visibility mask，SeCap 是 prompt recalibration + local refinement，DTST 是 token selection。B 必须避开“几何/可见性/局部选择”，把 SMPL 只用作诊断物理欠定度，不作为主模块。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.14513?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22268?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.06965?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.00433?utm_source=openai))

./pivot/p_2.md:728:./analyses/deep_21.txt:55:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何在输出特征上找可见区域”改成“如何在中间层阻断遮挡信息扩散，并用骨架区域补足关键点之间的外观”。关键词是 `occlusion information diffusion`、`decouple pedestrian features and occlusion information`、`visible appearance region attention`、`skeletal area modeling`、`skeleton-modulated cross-attention`。
./pivot/p_2.md:835:./analyses/deep_4.txt:53:1. 触发观察：作者先抓住两个失败现象。传统遮挡 ReID 依赖姿态、人体解析、attention 或遮挡增广，但它们都只看视觉，容易把遮挡物也当成身份特征。CLIP-ReID 引入语言后仍然不够，因为 prompt 是全局粗粒度的，文本主要用于对比监督，并没有直接指导模型区分“人、可见属性、遮挡物”。
./pivot/p_2.md:836:./analyses/deep_4.txt:55:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡问题重定义成 language-guided noise filtering，而不是简单的 visible part matching。更关键的是，他们把图像内容拆成三个语义类别：主体身份、可见属性、遮挡物。关键词是 categorical attention、fine-grained prompt、occlusion-aware prompt、subject token、attribute token、context token。这个重定义把“遮挡”从一个空间缺失问题变成了一个语义分类和噪声过滤问题。
./pivot/p_2.md:855:./analyses/deep_16.txt:32:4. 证据闭环：证据比较直接。可视化显示 DDO 把注意力从白墙、遮挡物拉回衣服、脸和可见身体；MSE、余弦误差和 SSIM 显示补全后特征更接近干净特征；DDO 插到 TransReID 和 Pass-ViT 也有增益。HRR 的证据更复杂，Occluded-Duke 上 mAP 从 81.8 到 90.6，但 Occluded-ReID 上会从 92.3 降到 90.1，作者也承认图库身份样本少或重遮挡时中心会偏。

./pivot/p_2.md:1061:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1524:1. 触发观察：作者先抓住两个失败现象。传统遮挡 ReID 依赖姿态、人体解析、attention 或遮挡增广，但它们都只看视觉，容易把遮挡物也当成身份特征。CLIP-ReID 引入语言后仍然不够，因为 prompt 是全局粗粒度的，文本主要用于对比监督，并没有直接指导模型区分“人、可见属性、遮挡物”。

./pivot/p_2.md:2269:./validate/v_2.md:7013:validate/v_3.md:1723:../codex_review_raw.txt:4434:experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",
./pivot/p_2.md:2270:./validate/v_2.md:7014:validate/v_3.md:1761:../codex_review_raw.txt:4966:./experiments/transfer_candidates.json:54:"transfer_to_occluded": "The noise-masking attribute alignment loss: because attribute pseudo-labels encode the collective/majority attribute semantics of an identity, an occluded image's predicted attribute token at an occluded body region will mismatch the identity-level pseudo-label. AG-ReID masks out per-attribute alignment pairs whose cosine similarity falls below a threshold (set automatically per-dataset via Otsu's method to maximize inter-class variance), so the loss is computed only on reliable (visible) attribute matches and noisy occluded ones are dropped. This is a concrete, annotation-free, self-supervised way to detect-and-discard occluded/corrupted local features during training using consistency against an identity-level prototype, and the Otsu auto-thresholding removes manual per-dataset tuning — directly applicable to suppressing occluder-corrupted part features in any part/attribute-based occluded ReID model.",

./pivot/p_2.md:5140:pivot/p_3.md:2015:Occluded-Duke 的遮挡**大比例是"另一个行人"而非物体**。全领域(167篇)把遮挡当"信息缺失→补全(completion/pose/part/CLIP)"。**真正失败不是缺信息, 而是 target embedding 被遮挡那个人的身份污染**——一个 distractor identity 泄漏进来。这是 source-separation 问题, 与全场"补全"范式正交。**没有一篇这么做。**
./pivot/p_2.md:5141:pivot/p_3.md:2018:- **重定义失败源**: co-present 入侵身份泄漏(可命名、可测), 非"遮挡难"。

./pivot/p_2.md:5709:pivot/p_2.md:728:./analyses/deep_21.txt:55:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何在输出特征上找可见区域”改成“如何在中间层阻断遮挡信息扩散，并用骨架区域补足关键点之间的外观”。关键词是 `occlusion information diffusion`、`decouple pedestrian features and occlusion information`、`visible appearance region attention`、`skeletal area modeling`、`skeleton-modulated cross-attention`。
./pivot/p_2.md:5735:pivot/p_2.md:835:./analyses/deep_4.txt:53:1. 触发观察：作者先抓住两个失败现象。传统遮挡 ReID 依赖姿态、人体解析、attention 或遮挡增广，但它们都只看视觉，容易把遮挡物也当成身份特征。CLIP-ReID 引入语言后仍然不够，因为 prompt 是全局粗粒度的，文本主要用于对比监督，并没有直接指导模型区分“人、可见属性、遮挡物”。
./pivot/p_2.md:5736:pivot/p_2.md:836:./analyses/deep_4.txt:55:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡问题重定义成 language-guided noise filtering，而不是简单的 visible part matching。更关键的是，他们把图像内容拆成三个语义类别：主体身份、可见属性、遮挡物。关键词是 categorical attention、fine-grained prompt、occlusion-aware prompt、subject token、attribute token、context token。这个重定义把“遮挡”从一个空间缺失问题变成了一个语义分类和噪声过滤问题。
./pivot/p_2.md:5746:pivot/p_2.md:855:./analyses/deep_16.txt:32:4. 证据闭环：证据比较直接。可视化显示 DDO 把注意力从白墙、遮挡物拉回衣服、脸和可见身体；MSE、余弦误差和 SSIM 显示补全后特征更接近干净特征；DDO 插到 TransReID 和 Pass-ViT 也有增益。HRR 的证据更复杂，Occluded-Duke 上 mAP 从 81.8 到 90.6，但 Occluded-ReID 上会从 92.3 降到 90.1，作者也承认图库身份样本少或重遮挡时中心会偏。

./pivot/p_2.md:6632:reviews/deep_4.md:11383:1. 触发观察：作者先抓住两个失败现象。传统遮挡 ReID 依赖姿态、人体解析、attention 或遮挡增广，但它们都只看视觉，容易把遮挡物也当成身份特征。CLIP-ReID 引入语言后仍然不够，因为 prompt 是全局粗粒度的，文本主要用于对比监督，并没有直接指导模型区分“人、可见属性、遮挡物”。
./pivot/p_2.md:6633:reviews/deep_4.md:11385:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡问题重定义成 language-guided noise filtering，而不是简单的 visible part matching。更关键的是，他们把图像内容拆成三个语义类别：主体身份、可见属性、遮挡物。关键词是 categorical attention、fine-grained prompt、occlusion-aware prompt、subject token、attribute token、context token。这个重定义把“遮挡”从一个空间缺失问题变成了一个语义分类和噪声过滤问题。

./pivot/p_2.md:6853:reviews/deep_25.md:549:- 只拦实质问题：代码正确性的错误、数据泄漏、评测协议前后不一致、变量没隔离干净、比较不公平。
./pivot/p_2.md:6912:reviews/deep_25.md:14095:1. **触发观察**：遮挡 ReID 里 pose、human parsing 和 occlusion augmentation 都常见，但作者指出两个更具体的失败场景：极端物体遮挡下，局部 pose 错误会污染全局特征；非目标行人遮挡下，遮挡者也有人体骨架，pose 无法区分目标和遮挡行人。作者还用了一个接近人类识别的观察：行人互相遮挡时，背包、伞、衣服纹理这类 distinctive appearance 往往决定识别。
./pivot/p_2.md:6913:reviews/deep_25.md:14097:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。
./pivot/p_2.md:6914:reviews/deep_25.md:14101:4. **证据闭环**：消融很干净。Occluded-Duke 上 baseline 是 59.4 rank-1、49.7 mAP；加 MFE 到 62.2、52.4；加 PPM 到 67.3、56.1；MFE+PPM 到 68.9、57.0；完整 TTPM 到 73.4、63.4。Occluded-REID 上从 72.1、67.6 到 86.8、82.2。TAD 还拆 CEL 和 TEL，证明上下文和纹理都贡献。可视化上，PPM 热图在极端遮挡下更集中到目标有效区域；检索图展示非目标行人遮挡时 TAD 能帮忙找回；失败案例也说明当目标和遮挡者纹理高度相似时仍会失败，这反而让机制边界更可信。
./pivot/p_2.md:6923:reviews/deep_25.md:14174:1. **触发观察**：遮挡 ReID 里 pose、human parsing 和 occlusion augmentation 都常见，但作者指出两个更具体的失败场景：极端物体遮挡下，局部 pose 错误会污染全局特征；非目标行人遮挡下，遮挡者也有人体骨架，pose 无法区分目标和遮挡行人。作者还用了一个接近人类识别的观察：行人互相遮挡时，背包、伞、衣服纹理这类 distinctive appearance 往往决定识别。

./pivot/p_2.md:6925:reviews/deep_25.md:14180:4. **证据闭环**：消融很干净。Occluded-Duke 上 baseline 是 59.4 rank-1、49.7 mAP；加 MFE 到 62.2、52.4；加 PPM 到 67.3、56.1；MFE+PPM 到 68.9、57.0；完整 TTPM 到 73.4、63.4。Occluded-REID 上从 72.1、67.6 到 86.8、82.2。TAD 还拆 CEL 和 TEL，证明上下文和纹理都贡献。可视化上，PPM 热图在极端遮挡下更集中到目标有效区域；检索图展示非目标行人遮挡时 TAD 能帮忙找回；失败案例也说明当目标和遮挡者纹理高度相似时仍会失败，这反而让机制边界更可信。
./pivot/p_2.md:6977:reviews/deep_1.md:8282:FOSENet 这一篇把两个常见问题连在一起：遮挡不是随机空洞，而是有语义的干扰物；局部特征不是只要盯关键区域，而是关键区域旁边的语义也能补足身份线索。它的机制基本就是从这两个重定义自然长出来的。
./pivot/p_2.md:6992:reviews/deep_1.md:10873:2. **重定义动作**：视频 ReID 被改写成“2D 视频外观不足，需要 3D 几何和 shape 作为稳定身份线索”。关键词是 `frame-level feature quality`、`3D modality`、`geometric information`、`shape cues`、`feature inconsistency`、`appearance confusion`。先例上，3D ReID 已有 OGNet 这类图像级 3D 尝试，但本文把位置卡在 video ReID 和 2D-3D 融合策略上。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.04569?utm_source=openai))
./pivot/p_2.md:6996:reviews/deep_1.md:10897:2. **重定义动作**：它把换衣 ReID 从“找更强的外观/形状特征”改成“让衣服线索失效，并强迫模型使用非衣服的人体语义”。关键词是 `visual shielding`、`clothing-irrelevant feature`、`human semantic attention`、`potential consistency`。语义像素替换已有先例，SAVS 的差异是把语义前景注意力和衣服屏蔽一致性联合起来。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.08387?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.11522?utm_source=openai))
./pivot/p_2.md:7000:reviews/deep_1.md:10907:1. **触发观察**：遮挡不是随机黑块，真实遮挡物有形状、有语义，而且经常遮住关键身份区域。另一个观察是 CNN 深层局部特征容易盯住单个中心或背景冗余语义，导致局部语义表达不足。
./pivot/p_2.md:7001:reviews/deep_1.md:10909:2. **重定义动作**：它把遮挡 ReID 从“增强遮挡鲁棒性”改成两个新问题：遮挡是语义干扰，不是随机缺失；关键局部区域需要邻近语义扩展，不是孤立地看。关键词是 `semantic-guided occlusion simulation`、`semantic differential features`、`local feature semantic expansion`、`semantic relevance`、`semantic continuity`。它和 FED 这类遮挡特征擦除/扩散方法相比，切入点更偏“如何构造更像真实干扰的训练样本”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.08740?utm_source=openai))
./pivot/p_2.md:7005:reviews/deep_1.md:10919:1. **触发观察**：3D skeleton ReID 已经出现手工特征、序列模型、图模型、监督/自监督/无监督等多条线，但缺少系统综述。传统外观 ReID 依赖 RGB、衣服、人脸，存在隐私、视角、背景和外观变化问题；skeleton 则有轻量、隐私友好、抗背景和视角变化的优势。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.15296?utm_source=openai))
./pivot/p_2.md:7011:reviews/deep_1.md:10954:2. **重定义动作**：视频 ReID 被改写成“2D 视频外观不足，需要 3D 几何和 shape 作为稳定身份线索”。关键词是 `frame-level feature quality`、`3D modality`、`geometric information`、`shape cues`、`feature inconsistency`、`appearance confusion`。先例上，3D ReID 已有 OGNet 这类图像级 3D 尝试，但本文把位置卡在 video ReID 和 2D-3D 融合策略上。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.04569?utm_source=openai))

./pivot/p_2.md:7251:reviews/deep_20.md:6390:2. 重定义动作：这是最值得学的一篇。它把“车辆是噪声”改写成“车辆是有结构的正向噪声”。关键词是 positive noise、positive-incentive noise、structured cross-domain noise、data-centric perspective、vehicle data as valuable training resource、without manual annotations。旧问题是遮挡建模，新问题是如何用真实跨域干扰物降低遮挡识别的不确定性。

./pivot/p_2.md:7257:reviews/deep_20.md:6467:2. 重定义动作：这是最值得学的一篇。它把“车辆是噪声”改写成“车辆是有结构的正向噪声”。关键词是 positive noise、positive-incentive noise、structured cross-domain noise、data-centric perspective、vehicle data as valuable training resource、without manual annotations。旧问题是遮挡建模，新问题是如何用真实跨域干扰物降低遮挡识别的不确定性。
./pivot/p_2.md:7271:analyses/deep_1.txt:19:2. **重定义动作**：视频 ReID 被改写成“2D 视频外观不足，需要 3D 几何和 shape 作为稳定身份线索”。关键词是 `frame-level feature quality`、`3D modality`、`geometric information`、`shape cues`、`feature inconsistency`、`appearance confusion`。先例上，3D ReID 已有 OGNet 这类图像级 3D 尝试，但本文把位置卡在 video ReID 和 2D-3D 融合策略上。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.04569?utm_source=openai))
./pivot/p_2.md:7275:analyses/deep_1.txt:43:2. **重定义动作**：它把换衣 ReID 从“找更强的外观/形状特征”改成“让衣服线索失效，并强迫模型使用非衣服的人体语义”。关键词是 `visual shielding`、`clothing-irrelevant feature`、`human semantic attention`、`potential consistency`。语义像素替换已有先例，SAVS 的差异是把语义前景注意力和衣服屏蔽一致性联合起来。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.08387?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.11522?utm_source=openai))
./pivot/p_2.md:7279:analyses/deep_1.txt:53:1. **触发观察**：遮挡不是随机黑块，真实遮挡物有形状、有语义，而且经常遮住关键身份区域。另一个观察是 CNN 深层局部特征容易盯住单个中心或背景冗余语义，导致局部语义表达不足。
./pivot/p_2.md:7280:analyses/deep_1.txt:55:2. **重定义动作**：它把遮挡 ReID 从“增强遮挡鲁棒性”改成两个新问题：遮挡是语义干扰，不是随机缺失；关键局部区域需要邻近语义扩展，不是孤立地看。关键词是 `semantic-guided occlusion simulation`、`semantic differential features`、`local feature semantic expansion`、`semantic relevance`、`semantic continuity`。它和 FED 这类遮挡特征擦除/扩散方法相比，切入点更偏“如何构造更像真实干扰的训练样本”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.08740?utm_source=openai))
./pivot/p_2.md:7284:analyses/deep_1.txt:65:1. **触发观察**：3D skeleton ReID 已经出现手工特征、序列模型、图模型、监督/自监督/无监督等多条线，但缺少系统综述。传统外观 ReID 依赖 RGB、衣服、人脸，存在隐私、视角、背景和外观变化问题；skeleton 则有轻量、隐私友好、抗背景和视角变化的优势。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.15296?utm_source=openai))

./pivot/p_2.md:7336:reviews/deep_23.md:3311:前两篇已经读到核心：一篇把遮挡解释成真实遮挡分布、文本语义缺失和增强后特征分布不一致三件事；另一篇把退化 ReID 从“单一退化域偏移”改写成“混合退化下的分布偏移加身份拓扑扭曲”。我会补一下被输出截断的中间方法细节，然后继续后四篇。
./pivot/p_2.md:7351:reviews/deep_23.md:8954:2. **重定义动作**：它把遮挡 ReID 从“局部特征缺失”改写成“遮挡分布不匹配加跨模态语义退化加增强特征分布不一致”。关键词是 `occlusion distribution mismatch`、`semantic degradation`、`prompt-distribution synergy`、`region-prioritized erasure`。
./pivot/p_2.md:7352:reviews/deep_23.md:8955:3. **机制怎么长出来**：RPE 从真实遮挡分布自然推出，下半身优先擦除。DMPA 从“语义缺失”推出，在文本 prompt 上做双重 mask，用文本到文本对比让身份文本原型对缺失语义稳定。MDO 从“增强后分布不一致”推出，在特征空间做擦除、噪声、局部替换，再用两步对抗优化逼原始和扰动特征一致。RPE 和重定义绑定最紧，DMPA 次之，MDO 更像通用鲁棒性补强。
./pivot/p_2.md:7369:reviews/deep_23.md:9004:2. **重定义动作**：它把遮挡 ReID 从“局部特征缺失”改写成“遮挡分布不匹配加跨模态语义退化加增强特征分布不一致”。关键词是 `occlusion distribution mismatch`、`semantic degradation`、`prompt-distribution synergy`、`region-prioritized erasure`。
./pivot/p_2.md:7370:reviews/deep_23.md:9005:3. **机制怎么长出来**：RPE 从真实遮挡分布自然推出，下半身优先擦除。DMPA 从“语义缺失”推出，在文本 prompt 上做双重 mask，用文本到文本对比让身份文本原型对缺失语义稳定。MDO 从“增强后分布不一致”推出，在特征空间做擦除、噪声、局部替换，再用两步对抗优化逼原始和扰动特征一致。RPE 和重定义绑定最紧，DMPA 次之，MDO 更像通用鲁棒性补强。

./pivot/p_2.md:7443:reviews/deep_2.md:13267:1. **触发观察**：作者抓住遮挡 ReID 里两种局部特征方案的失败。人工水平切块会因为尺度和姿态导致部位错位；姿态估计能缓解错位，但对噪声敏感，还会忽略包、伞、手提物这类非身体但有身份辨识度的线索，而且引入额外模型复杂度。
./pivot/p_2.md:7447:reviews/deep_2.md:13291:1. **触发观察**：作者抓住换衣 ReID 的两个常见依赖：一类靠姿态、轮廓、步态等生物线索，遇到遮挡、低光、质量差会不稳；一类做衣服与身份解耦，可能引入额外计算、失真和训练不稳定。另一个关键观察是 ViT 不同层的 attention map 关注内容明显不同，但很多 ReID 模型只用最后一层。

./pivot/p_2.md:7708:analyses/deep_14.txt:25:1. 触发观察：作者抓的是 Transformer 遮挡 ReID 的通病，patch 被近似一视同仁处理，没有量化不同 patch 对身份的贡献，也缺少足够强的局部细节抽取能力。
./pivot/p_2.md:7719:analyses/deep_20.txt:65:1. 触发观察：遮挡 ReID 里车辆遮挡很常见，论文说 Occluded-Duke query 中 vehicle-induced occlusion 占比超过 40%，但车辆图像通常被当成无关噪声丢掉。作者反过来观察到，车辆图像有真实纹理、颜色、视角和相机偏置，而且很容易从车牌系统收集。

./pivot/p_2.md:7753:analyses/deep_16.txt:30:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡从“需要鲁棒特征”改写成“特征空间里的结构化污染，需要反变换恢复干净身份表征”。关键词是 feature-level inpainting、inverse transform、clean identity-preserving embedding、de-occlusion、centroid-guided pruning。
./pivot/p_2.md:7754:analyses/deep_16.txt:31:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果接受“遮挡是特征污染”，扩散式去噪补全就很自然。DDO 用冻结 ViT 的干净特征作监督，把遮挡特征恢复成干净特征。HRR 则利用身份中心先筛候选，再做局部重排序。不过 HRR 依赖闭集身份结构，协议风险比 DDO 大。
./pivot/p_2.md:7755:analyses/deep_16.txt:32:4. 证据闭环：证据比较直接。可视化显示 DDO 把注意力从白墙、遮挡物拉回衣服、脸和可见身体；MSE、余弦误差和 SSIM 显示补全后特征更接近干净特征；DDO 插到 TransReID 和 Pass-ViT 也有增益。HRR 的证据更复杂，Occluded-Duke 上 mAP 从 81.8 到 90.6，但 Occluded-ReID 上会从 92.3 降到 90.1，作者也承认图库身份样本少或重遮挡时中心会偏。

./pivot/p_2.md:7882:reviews/deep_22.md:1516:remains completely unseen during training. The second protocol involves monitoring performance on both the source
./pivot/p_2.md:7917:analyses/deep_7.txt:41:1. 触发观察：视频 ReID 的全局特征会混入遮挡、检测框错误、背景；局部 part 特征又有对齐问题。硬条带太粗，外部 pose/parsing 计算重，还会把背包、手提包这类有身份价值的上下文当背景。
./pivot/p_2.md:7922:analyses/deep_23.txt:5:2. **重定义动作**：它把遮挡 ReID 从“局部特征缺失”改写成“遮挡分布不匹配加跨模态语义退化加增强特征分布不一致”。关键词是 `occlusion distribution mismatch`、`semantic degradation`、`prompt-distribution synergy`、`region-prioritized erasure`。
./pivot/p_2.md:7923:analyses/deep_23.txt:6:3. **机制怎么长出来**：RPE 从真实遮挡分布自然推出，下半身优先擦除。DMPA 从“语义缺失”推出，在文本 prompt 上做双重 mask，用文本到文本对比让身份文本原型对缺失语义稳定。MDO 从“增强后分布不一致”推出，在特征空间做擦除、噪声、局部替换，再用两步对抗优化逼原始和扰动特征一致。RPE 和重定义绑定最紧，DMPA 次之，MDO 更像通用鲁棒性补强。
./pivot/p_2.md:7941:analyses/deep_4.txt:53:1. 触发观察：作者先抓住两个失败现象。传统遮挡 ReID 依赖姿态、人体解析、attention 或遮挡增广，但它们都只看视觉，容易把遮挡物也当成身份特征。CLIP-ReID 引入语言后仍然不够，因为 prompt 是全局粗粒度的，文本主要用于对比监督，并没有直接指导模型区分“人、可见属性、遮挡物”。
./pivot/p_2.md:7942:analyses/deep_4.txt:55:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡问题重定义成 language-guided noise filtering，而不是简单的 visible part matching。更关键的是，他们把图像内容拆成三个语义类别：主体身份、可见属性、遮挡物。关键词是 categorical attention、fine-grained prompt、occlusion-aware prompt、subject token、attribute token、context token。这个重定义把“遮挡”从一个空间缺失问题变成了一个语义分类和噪声过滤问题。
./pivot/p_2.md:7952:analyses/deep_3.txt:29:1. 触发观察：CLIP-ReID 类方法已经很强，但它依赖整体语义提示，在遮挡和细粒度相似行人上容易只看主特征，漏掉头发、包、衣服细节。CLIP-ReID 与 CoOp 是它的直接技术背景。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.13977?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.01134?utm_source=openai))
./pivot/p_2.md:7971:analyses/deep_25.txt:65:1. **触发观察**：遮挡 ReID 里 pose、human parsing 和 occlusion augmentation 都常见，但作者指出两个更具体的失败场景：极端物体遮挡下，局部 pose 错误会污染全局特征；非目标行人遮挡下，遮挡者也有人体骨架，pose 无法区分目标和遮挡行人。作者还用了一个接近人类识别的观察：行人互相遮挡时，背包、伞、衣服纹理这类 distinctive appearance 往往决定识别。
./pivot/p_2.md:7972:analyses/deep_25.txt:67:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。
./pivot/p_2.md:7973:analyses/deep_25.txt:71:4. **证据闭环**：消融很干净。Occluded-Duke 上 baseline 是 59.4 rank-1、49.7 mAP；加 MFE 到 62.2、52.4；加 PPM 到 67.3、56.1；MFE+PPM 到 68.9、57.0；完整 TTPM 到 73.4、63.4。Occluded-REID 上从 72.1、67.6 到 86.8、82.2。TAD 还拆 CEL 和 TEL，证明上下文和纹理都贡献。可视化上，PPM 热图在极端遮挡下更集中到目标有效区域；检索图展示非目标行人遮挡时 TAD 能帮忙找回；失败案例也说明当目标和遮挡者纹理高度相似时仍会失败，这反而让机制边界更可信。
./pivot/p_2.md:7987:analyses/deep_21.txt:13:5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：买账点主要是视角和任务定义，不是图注意力或 KL 本身多新。它把“遮挡 VI-ReID”讲成一个尚未充分处理的交叉问题：缺失身份线索和跨模态错位同时发生。因此模块虽然常见，但被一个清楚的问题链条串住了。
./pivot/p_2.md:7990:analyses/deep_21.txt:55:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何在输出特征上找可见区域”改成“如何在中间层阻断遮挡信息扩散，并用骨架区域补足关键点之间的外观”。关键词是 `occlusion information diffusion`、`decouple pedestrian features and occlusion information`、`visible appearance region attention`、`skeletal area modeling`、`skeleton-modulated cross-attention`。
./pivot/p_2.md:8001:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:21:2. **重定义动作**：视频 ReID 被改写成“2D 视频外观不足，需要 3D 几何和 shape 作为稳定身份线索”。关键词是 `frame-level feature quality`、`3D modality`、`geometric information`、`shape cues`、`feature inconsistency`、`appearance confusion`。先例上，3D ReID 已有 OGNet 这类图像级 3D 尝试，但本文把位置卡在 video ReID 和 2D-3D 融合策略上。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2006.04569?utm_source=openai))
./pivot/p_2.md:8005:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:45:2. **重定义动作**：它把换衣 ReID 从“找更强的外观/形状特征”改成“让衣服线索失效，并强迫模型使用非衣服的人体语义”。关键词是 `visual shielding`、`clothing-irrelevant feature`、`human semantic attention`、`potential consistency`。语义像素替换已有先例，SAVS 的差异是把语义前景注意力和衣服屏蔽一致性联合起来。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.08387?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.11522?utm_source=openai))
./pivot/p_2.md:8009:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:55:1. **触发观察**：遮挡不是随机黑块，真实遮挡物有形状、有语义，而且经常遮住关键身份区域。另一个观察是 CNN 深层局部特征容易盯住单个中心或背景冗余语义，导致局部语义表达不足。
./pivot/p_2.md:8010:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:57:2. **重定义动作**：它把遮挡 ReID 从“增强遮挡鲁棒性”改成两个新问题：遮挡是语义干扰，不是随机缺失；关键局部区域需要邻近语义扩展，不是孤立地看。关键词是 `semantic-guided occlusion simulation`、`semantic differential features`、`local feature semantic expansion`、`semantic relevance`、`semantic continuity`。它和 FED 这类遮挡特征擦除/扩散方法相比，切入点更偏“如何构造更像真实干扰的训练样本”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.08740?utm_source=openai))
./pivot/p_2.md:8014:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:67:1. **触发观察**：3D skeleton ReID 已经出现手工特征、序列模型、图模型、监督/自监督/无监督等多条线，但缺少系统综述。传统外观 ReID 依赖 RGB、衣服、人脸，存在隐私、视角、背景和外观变化问题；skeleton 则有轻量、隐私友好、抗背景和视角变化的优势。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.15296?utm_source=openai))
./pivot/p_2.md:8034:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:363:1. 触发观察：作者抓的是 Transformer 遮挡 ReID 的通病，patch 被近似一视同仁处理，没有量化不同 patch 对身份的贡献，也缺少足够强的局部细节抽取能力。
./pivot/p_2.md:8066:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:462:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡从“需要鲁棒特征”改写成“特征空间里的结构化污染，需要反变换恢复干净身份表征”。关键词是 feature-level inpainting、inverse transform、clean identity-preserving embedding、de-occlusion、centroid-guided pruning。
./pivot/p_2.md:8067:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:463:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果接受“遮挡是特征污染”，扩散式去噪补全就很自然。DDO 用冻结 ViT 的干净特征作监督，把遮挡特征恢复成干净特征。HRR 则利用身份中心先筛候选，再做局部重排序。不过 HRR 依赖闭集身份结构，协议风险比 DDO 大。
./pivot/p_2.md:8068:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:464:4. 证据闭环：证据比较直接。可视化显示 DDO 把注意力从白墙、遮挡物拉回衣服、脸和可见身体；MSE、余弦误差和 SSIM 显示补全后特征更接近干净特征；DDO 插到 TransReID 和 Pass-ViT 也有增益。HRR 的证据更复杂，Occluded-Duke 上 mAP 从 81.8 到 90.6，但 Occluded-ReID 上会从 92.3 降到 90.1，作者也承认图库身份样本少或重遮挡时中心会偏。
./pivot/p_2.md:8100:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:735:1. **触发观察**：作者抓住遮挡 ReID 里两种局部特征方案的失败。人工水平切块会因为尺度和姿态导致部位错位；姿态估计能缓解错位，但对噪声敏感，还会忽略包、伞、手提物这类非身体但有身份辨识度的线索，而且引入额外模型复杂度。
./pivot/p_2.md:8104:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:759:1. **触发观察**：作者抓住换衣 ReID 的两个常见依赖：一类靠姿态、轮廓、步态等生物线索，遇到遮挡、低光、质量差会不稳；一类做衣服与身份解耦，可能引入额外计算、失真和训练不稳定。另一个关键观察是 ViT 不同层的 attention map 关注内容明显不同，但很多 ReID 模型只用最后一层。
./pivot/p_2.md:8109:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:840:1. 触发观察：遮挡 ReID 里车辆遮挡很常见，论文说 Occluded-Duke query 中 vehicle-induced occlusion 占比超过 40%，但车辆图像通常被当成无关噪声丢掉。作者反过来观察到，车辆图像有真实纹理、颜色、视角和相机偏置，而且很容易从车牌系统收集。
./pivot/p_2.md:8110:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:842:2. 重定义动作：这是最值得学的一篇。它把“车辆是噪声”改写成“车辆是有结构的正向噪声”。关键词是 positive noise、positive-incentive noise、structured cross-domain noise、data-centric perspective、vehicle data as valuable training resource、without manual annotations。旧问题是遮挡建模，新问题是如何用真实跨域干扰物降低遮挡识别的不确定性。
./pivot/p_2.md:8116:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:865:5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：买账点主要是视角和任务定义，不是图注意力或 KL 本身多新。它把“遮挡 VI-ReID”讲成一个尚未充分处理的交叉问题：缺失身份线索和跨模态错位同时发生。因此模块虽然常见，但被一个清楚的问题链条串住了。

./pivot/p_2.md:8212:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1861:1. 触发观察：图像级 VI-ReID 方法处理不了视频里的姿态、运动、遮挡和时序变化。已有 VVI-ReID 多在帧级做模态不变，序列级特征聚合后仍有模态差异，而且 modal-related 信息会继续干扰身份判别。

./pivot/p_2.md:8295:./reviews/deep_2.md:1065:The proposed domain adaptation framework operates in joint training mode through the following workﬂow: Labeled source domain images and unlabeled target domain samples are aggregated and partitioned into mini-batches containing equal proportions of both domains.
./pivot/p_2.md:8427:./validate/clean/v_2.txt:16:- vs **probabilistic embedding / uncertainty ReID**：PCME 用概率分布处理图文一对多对应，DUL/ReID uncertainty 用后验/先验高斯建模样本不确定性；它们不是 cross-view 物理方向的包含关系。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.05068?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.08785))
./pivot/p_2.md:8428:./validate/clean/v_2.txt:18:- vs **AGPReID 红海**：VDT 是 view-related/view-unrelated decoupling，GSAlign 是 TPS 几何 warp + visibility mask，SeCap 是 prompt recalibration + local refinement，DTST 是 token selection。B 必须避开“几何/可见性/局部选择”，把 SMPL 只用作诊断物理欠定度，不作为主模块。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.14513?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22268?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.06965?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.00433?utm_source=openai))
./pivot/p_2.md:8429:./validate/clean/v_2.txt:19:- vs **cross-resolution ReID**：PS-HRNet/RFD 这类线主要做恢复、变换或 resolution-invariant feature；B 的说法应是“不幻想补齐不可见细节，而是显式表达候选身份范围”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.11722?utm_source=openai))

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/decisions.md:1491:- 🔴 红队（方案 A）核心论点: SGMKC 实现成本极低（~15 行代码，无新参数），属于不同类别的改进（训练方法论 vs 架构/loss 添加），skeleton graph + masked prediction 组合是真正新颖的（FCFormer 用 transformer decoder，MAE 用 random patches，没有人在 skeleton graph 上做过 masked completion for ReID）。47 个失败实验都是架构添加或 loss 变体，SGMKC 是 self-supervised 训练策略——不同搜索空间。即使失败，负面结论也有论文价值。信心: 6/10
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/decisions.md:1576:- 🔵 蓝队（方案 B: PPE）核心论点: 重新定义遮挡问题（从 visibility mask 到 uncertainty quantification），pose confidence → feature uncertainty 的因果链是全新机制。论文理论深度更强（概率嵌入+信息几何）。与 PSG 正交互补（PSG 管特征提取，PPE 管匹配）。P3E/DUL 已验证概率嵌入在 ReID 中可训练。攻击 A: PAB 已在同范式失败（attention bias 变体），CLAUDE.md 警告"attention trick"，2.8K 参数太小难以撑论文主贡献，12x4 分辨率太粗糙。信心: 7/10

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/decisions.md:4552:**方法(无训练)**: per-part token = SkeletonGCNHead 在 PSG-modulated Stage-3 图上按 17 COCO kp bilinear 采样的 token(dim 1024, pre/post-GCN)。按 pose 置信度 score 把每 kp 的 token 分 high-vis(≥0.7) vs low-vis/遮挡(≤0.2), 算逐通道对角高斯对称 KL + 2-Wasserstein + Fisher-LDA held-out AUC。三对照排伪影: %border 坐标、KL(hi,**rand** 体内随机采样)、KL(hi,**lo_onbody** 剔边界坐标)。

一个做行人 ReID 的团队要发 CCF-B **方法稿**, 刚连续用零训练 kill-switch 干净杀掉两个方向:
- **死1**: 航拍-地面'物理定向不确定性包含'——前提 σ_aerial<σ_ground(航拍其实更平滑)就错, 包含'收益'是检索 artifact。
- **死2(刚)**: GOPL'正样本关系粒度错了'(用 SMPL 共同可见人体表面 overlap 当 same-ID 正边可靠性)。冻结最强 occluded_duke ckpt(exp255, sanity mAP73.05≈训练73.2)测: cosine 距离确实弱负相关 overlap(rho≈-0.13)但: D5 随机关节子集打平(-0.1294≈真-0.1273)、cov2d 控住可见关节数后归零(+0.0145)、#vis 关节数 baseline 反而更强(-0.1321)、相机对(视角差)解释方差 eta²0.062 比 SMPL cov 0.018 还大、cov3d(3D自遮挡)没明显强于 cov2d → 隐藏变量是'遮挡越重越难'(occlusion-count)不是'共同可见表面', SMPL 几何=VPM/QPM/occlusion-count 换名无独特信号。

**残酷 meta-pattern**: 团队'独有资产'SMPL/人体几何**反复 reduce to 廉价代理**——exp333 SMPL-β≈random、pose 融 CLIP 五角度全死、SMPL-anchor VI-ReID 死、GOPL cov≈occlusion-count+view-diff。**SMPL 对 ReID 没有超出 occlusion-count/视角的独特判别信号。** 团队三大资产全弱: ①SMPL/几何(反复证伪) ②遮挡 ReID(历史5死角+三堵墙 completion/occluder-gate/visibility, exp109 oracle headroom 是 identity-conditioned 不可实现的墙) ③航拍-地面(ViSA/GSAlign/SeCap/DTST 占满+转 video/challenge)。**真的硬资产只有强 Swin/SOLIDER backbone**(occluded_duke 73.2 / CARGO 67.3)但那是 backbone 非方法。可用数据: occluded_duke / market / MSMT17 / CARGO / AG-ReID.v2 / occluded_reid。

方法论(团队读167篇方法稿总结): B类创新=失败观察→重定义隐藏变量→机制自然长出→证重定义对。22招式(数学化/可测中间变量/对齐伤判别/因果/改信号角色/顺序错了/新协议/非对称包含/数据中心反直觉/旧法在新基座失效等)。

2. **重定义动作**：作者把问题讲成“跨模态对齐缺少显式、模态无关的 semantic anchor”，而不是“再做一个 CLIP prompt”。关键词是 attribute-aware text、contour-aware text prompt、text re-definition、category-level textual prototypes、modality-agnostic semantic anchors。这个重定义把文本从辅助描述变成“RGB 和 IR 共同对齐的类别原型”。

3. **机制怎么长出来**：ATG 用 BLIP 问答和固定模板生成属性文本，并刻意避开颜色，保留 age、gender、action、clothing type、hair、glasses 这些更跨模态的属性。CTP 用 SCHP 人体解析去掉衣服区域，保留 body shape 和 pose 相关区域，再用可学习 prompt 表示 contour-aware class text。TRM 负责把 instance-level attribute text 和 class-level contour prompt 融成 image-aware redefined text，最后做 class-level text prototype，指导 RGB 和 IR visual feature 对齐。机制和“属性语义加结构语义”的问题定义是匹配的，但整体偏组合式。

4. **证据闭环**：核心消融在 SYSU-MM01。baseline 是 72.25 mAP、75.22 rank-1；加 ATG 到 73.28、76.47；加 CTP 到 73.13、76.21；ATG+CTP 到 74.86、77.85；完整 TRM 到 76.21、78.52。这个表刚好证明三个判断：属性文本有用，轮廓文本也有用，两者互补，TRM 不是多余融合。作者还和传统 VI-ReID 以及语言模型方法对比，强调 richer textual prompts 能更好指导视觉编码器提取 modality-invariant feature。

5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：这篇卖的主要是视角，不是模块精巧度。reviewer 买账点是它把“文本提示”拆成两类可解释语义：属性和轮廓，并用 prototype 把文本变成跨模态锚点。novelty 的来源是“显式语义原型替代弱 token proxy”，而不是 BLIP、SCHP、CLIP 或 Transformer decoder 本身。

**5. Text-to-image Person Search based on Semantic Reorganization.pdf**

1. **触发观察**：TBPS 数据少，原因是隐私和文本标注成本高。已有增强要么靠大规模外部数据和 MLLM 预训练，要么靠 diffusion 编辑图像，成本高，还追求视觉真实但不一定提高检索。作者还观察到传统 re-ranking 的 k-reciprocal 假设在文本到图像里不成立，因为文本特征没有稳定的同模态局部邻域，text-image 距离分布也不平衡。

2. **重定义动作**：他们把数据增强从“生成逼真的人图”重定义为“基于行人结构语义单元做组合扩展”。关键词是 semantic reorganization、semantic restructuring-based data augmentation、structural combinatorial enhancement、training enhancement + testing calibration、cross-modal similarity re-ranking。旧问题从“缺真实图片”变成“缺足够多上身、下身、语义组合变化”；从“排序不准”变成“文本 query 需要可靠跨模态邻域来校准”。

3. **机制怎么长出来**：SRDA 很直接：先用 MLLM 判断性别，在同一性别内随机选两个 ID，把一个人的上半身和另一个人的下半身横向拼接，生成新 ID，再用微调 BLIP 为新图生成文本。它不追求自然，而追求结构组合多样性。CSRM 则在测试时为文本 query 找 cross-modal k-reciprocal 图像邻居，用 Jaccard 权重把可靠图像特征融合进文本特征，再检索。训练阶段用 CLIP 双流、ID loss、SDM loss 和 image triplet；不加 text triplet，因为 MLLM 文本有噪声。

4. **证据闭环**：组件消融直接对应两个重定义。CUHK-PEDES baseline 是 70.79 rank-1、64.69 mAP；SRDA 到 74.35、69.63；CSRM 到 72.02、68.13；完整 PSSR 到 75.71、73.34。ICFG-PEDES 从 61.30、37.68 到 65.91、48.11，RSTPReid 从 59.20、46.65 到 62.53、51.77。传统 re-ranking 在 CUHK 上 rank-1 反而从 74.35 降到 68.68，而 CSRM 到 75.71，这很好地证明“同模态 re-ranking 假设不适用于跨模态”。高伪影样本也能涨点，低伪影和高伪影一起最好，支撑“视觉真实不是核心，多样性才是核心”。

5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：这篇卖的是两个务实视角：训练时不迷信 diffusion 真实感，测试时不照搬同模态 re-ranking。机制都很简单，但和观察贴得紧，消融也正好打在 reviewer 会怀疑的点上。novelty 来源不是复杂模型，而是对 TBPS 任务目标的重新理解。

**6. Texture-aware transformer with pose-patch mapping for occluded person re-identification.pdf**

1. **触发观察**：遮挡 ReID 里 pose、human parsing 和 occlusion augmentation 都常见，但作者指出两个更具体的失败场景：极端物体遮挡下，局部 pose 错误会污染全局特征；非目标行人遮挡下，遮挡者也有人体骨架，pose 无法区分目标和遮挡行人。作者还用了一个接近人类识别的观察：行人互相遮挡时，背包、伞、衣服纹理这类 distinctive appearance 往往决定识别。

2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。

3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFE 先在 ViT patch 上做 intra-patch 和 inter-patch 编码，补足 patch 内外层级信息。PPM 不做 pose-to-global，而是把 pose 和 patch 当成两种模态，用 Mahalanobis distance 加 cosine similarity 建 pose-patch 相似矩阵，只保留高置信关键点对应的 patch，从而降低局部 pose 错误的全局污染。TAD 再用 context extraction layer 和 texture extraction layer，以 PPM 过滤后的 pose 特征为约束，通过 cross-attention 强化可区分纹理。pose loss 还约束人体和非人体映射特征不要太相似。机制和两个失败场景绑定得比较紧。

4. **证据闭环**：消融很干净。Occluded-Duke 上 baseline 是 59.4 rank-1、49.7 mAP；加 MFE 到 62.2、52.4；加 PPM 到 67.3、56.1；MFE+PPM 到 68.9、57.0；完整 TTPM 到 73.4、63.4。Occluded-REID 上从 72.1、67.6 到 86.8、82.2。TAD 还拆 CEL 和 TEL，证明上下文和纹理都贡献。可视化上，PPM 热图在极端遮挡下更集中到目标有效区域；检索图展示非目标行人遮挡时 TAD 能帮忙找回；失败案例也说明当目标和遮挡者纹理高度相似时仍会失败，这反而让机制边界更可信。

5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：这篇卖的是“对遮挡失败类型的细分”加“机制一一对应”。如果只说 pose+texture，novelty 会弱；但作者先指出 pose 方法在极端遮挡和行人遮挡下分别为什么失效，再让 PPM 和 TAD 分别处理，reviewer 就更容易接受。真正 novelty 来自问题拆解，而不是 Transformer、pose 或 attention 本身。

**共同套路**

这批论文共同不是先发明一个模块，而是先把已有任务里的默认说法改窄、改具体：事件 ReID 不是 RGB 迁移，VI-ReID 不只是 modality gap，换衣 ReID 不只是加 gait，遮挡 ReID 不只是找可见部位。它们能成稿的关键是把观察变成一句新的失败机制，然后让方法的每个部件都对应这个失败机制，最后用“替换模态、破坏假设、组件拆分、可视化”证明视角本身是对的。

########## deep_26 ##########
我基于本地 PDF 的方法和补读页拆解。判断重点放在“观察怎样变成问题”，不是复述模块。

**1. TIENet**

1. 触发观察：多模态 ReID 不是缺一个融合层，而是现有方法大多只在空间域融合，忽略频域差异和模态间关系。作者用傅里叶可视化发现，相位主要保留结构，幅度更能区分模态和身份。

2. 重定义动作：他们把“多模态融合”重定义为“三类交互不足”。关键词是频域和空间域交互、模态间交互、模态内人体结构交互。这样旧问题从“怎么拼 RGB、近红外、热红外”变成“怎么分别保留模态特异性和互补性”。

3. 机制怎么长出来：SFI 用幅度注意力引导相位，再用空间卷积保留局部细节；IMMI 用相似度掩码做自适应模态交互；IMFF 用位置注意力建模身体局部上下文；MAS loss 同时做模态间分离和模态内聚合。SFI 和观察绑定最紧，IMFF 更像补强模块，逻辑稍泛。

analyses/deep_15.txt:19:2. **重定义动作**：它把问题从“学习衣服无关特征”改成“在衣服相关区域中解耦身份相关信息”。关键词是 `identity-aware feature decoupling`、`ID-based knowledge transfer`、`clothing bias diminishing`、`clothing contrastive loss`。大家以为衣服区域要被抑制，其实衣服区域里还藏着体型、轮廓等身份线索，关键是别让颜色纹理主导。
